shelf.name: Display Shelf
shelf.desc: It looks great even when it's empty.
shelf.effect:
Displays cherished items and increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

Must be installed on a back wall.

fossilsculpture.name: Fossil Block
fossilsculpture.desc: Duplicants who have learned art skills can produce more decorative sculptures.
fossilsculpture.effect:
Majorly increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

ceilingfossilsculpture.name: Hanging Fossil Block
ceilingfossilsculpture.desc: Duplicants who have learned art skills can produce more decorative ceiling sculptures.
ceilingfossilsculpture.effect:
Majorly increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

headquarterscomplete.name: Printing Pod
headquarterscomplete.unique_poptext:
A clone of the cloning machine? What a novel thought.

Alas, it won't work.

exobaseheadquarters.name: Mini-Pod
exobaseheadquarters.desc: A quick and easy substitute, though it'll never live up to the original.
exobaseheadquarters.effect:
A portable bioprinter that produces new Duplicants or care packages containing resources.

Only one Printing Pod or Mini-Pod is permitted per Planetoid.

airconditioner.name: Thermo Regulator
airconditioner.desc: A thermo regulator doesn't remove heat, but relocates it to a new area.
airconditioner.effect: Cools the Gas piped through it, but outputs Heat in its immediate vicinity.

staterpillaregg.name: Slug Egg
staterpillaregg.desc: The electrifying egg of the Plug Slug.
staterpillaregg.effect: Slug Eggs can be connected to a Power circuit as an energy source.

beehive.name: Beeta Hive
beehive.desc:
A moderately Radioactive nest made by Beetas.

Converts Uranium Ore into Enriched Uranium when worked by a Beeta.
Will not function if ground below has been destroyed.
beehive.effect: The cozy home of a Beeta.

ethanoldistillery.name: Ethanol Distiller
ethanoldistillery.desc: Ethanol distillers convert Wood into burnable Ethanol fuel.

algaedistillery.name: Algae Distiller
algaedistillery.desc: Algae distillers convert disease-causing slime into algae for oxygen production.

gunkemptier.name: Gunk Extractor
gunkemptier.desc: Bionic Duplicants are much more relaxed after a visit to the gunk extractor.
gunkemptier.effect: Cleanses stale Gunk build-up from Duplicants' bionic parts.

oilchanger.name: Lubrication Station
oilchanger.desc: A fresh supply of oil keeps the ol' joints from getting too creaky.
oilchanger.effect: Uses Gear Oil to keep Duplicants' bionic parts running smoothly.

oxyliterefinery.name: Oxylite Refinery
oxyliterefinery.desc: Oxylite is a solid and easily transportable source of consumable oxygen.
oxyliterefinery.effect: Synthesizes Oxylite using Oxygen and a small amount of Gold.

oxysconce.name: Oxylite Sconce
oxysconce.desc: Sconces prevent diffused oxygen from being wasted inside storage bins.
oxysconce.effect: Stores a small chunk of Oxylite which gradually releases Oxygen into the environment.

fertilizermaker.name: Fertilizer Synthesizer
fertilizermaker.desc: Fertilizer synthesizers convert polluted dirt into fertilizer for domestic plants.
fertilizermaker.effect: Uses Polluted Water and Phosphorite to produce Fertilizer.

algaehabitat.name: Algae Terrarium
algaehabitat.desc: Algae colony, Duplicant colony... we're more alike than we are different.
algaehabitat.effect:
Consumes Algae to produce Oxygen and remove some Carbon Dioxide.

Gains a 10% efficiency boost in direct Light.

battery.name: Battery
battery.desc: Batteries allow power from generators to be stored for later.
battery.effect:
Stores Power from generators, then provides that power to buildings.

Loses charge over time.

flyingcreaturebait.name: Airborne Critter Bait
flyingcreaturebait.desc: The type of critter attracted by critter bait depends on the construction material.
flyingcreaturebait.effect:
Attracts one type of airborne critter.

Single use.

watertrap.name: Fish Trap
watertrap.desc: Trapped fish will automatically be bagged for transport.
watertrap.effect:
Attracts and traps swimming Pacu.

Only Duplicants with the Critter Ranching I skill can arm this trap. It's reusable!

reusabletrap.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal when a critter has been trapped
reusabletrap.input_logic_port_inactive: Red Signal: Disarm and empty trap

creatureairtrap.name: Airborne Critter Trap
creatureairtrap.desc: It needs to be armed prior to use.
creatureairtrap.effect:
Attracts and captures airborne Critters.

Only Duplicants with the Critter Ranching I skill can arm this trap. It's reusable!

airbornecreaturelure.name: Airborne Critter Lure
airbornecreaturelure.desc: Lures can relocate Pufts or Shine Bugs to specific locations in my colony.
airbornecreaturelure.effect:
Attracts one type of airborne critter at a time.

Must be baited with Slime or Phosphorite.

batterymedium.name: Jumbo Battery
batterymedium.desc: Larger batteries hold more power and keep systems running longer before recharging.
batterymedium.effect:
Stores Power from generators, then provides that power to buildings.

Slightly loses charge over time.

batterysmart.name: Smart Battery
batterysmart.desc: Smart batteries send a Green Signal when they require charging.
batterysmart.effect:
Stores Power from generators, then provides that power to buildings.

Sends a Green Signal or Red Signal based on the configuration of the Logic Activation Parameters.

Very slightly loses charge over time.
batterysmart.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal when battery is less than Low Threshold charged, until High Threshold is reached again
batterysmart.logic_port_inactive: Sends a Red Signal when the battery is more than High Threshold charged, until Low Threshold is reached again
batterysmart.activate_tooltip: Sends a Green Signal when battery is less than {0}% charged, until it is {1}% (High Threshold) charged
batterysmart.deactivate_tooltip: Sends a Red Signal when battery is {0}% charged, until it is less than {1}% (Low Threshold) charged

bed.name: Cot
bed.desc: Duplicants without a bed will develop sore backs from sleeping on the floor.
bed.effect:
Gives one Duplicant a place to sleep.

Duplicants will automatically return to their cots to sleep at night.

starcurtain.name: Stargazer Cot
starcurtain.desc: Now Duplicants can sleep beneath the stars without wearing an Atmo Suit to bed.

sciencelab.name: Lab Cot
sciencelab.desc: For the Duplicant who dreams of scientific discoveries.

staycation.name: Staycation Cot
staycation.desc: Like a weekend away, except... not.

stringlights.name: Good Job Cot
stringlights.desc: Wrapped in shiny gold stars, to help sleepy Duplicants feel accomplished.

bottleemptier.name: Bottle Emptier
bottleemptier.desc: A bottle emptier's Element Filter can be used to designate areas for specific liquid storage.
bottleemptier.effect: Empties bottled Liquids back into the world.

bottleemptiergas.name: Canister Emptier
bottleemptiergas.desc: A canister emptier's Element Filter can designate areas for specific gas storage.
bottleemptiergas.effect: Empties Gas canisters back into the world.

bottleemptierconduitliquid.name: Bottle Drainer
bottleemptierconduitliquid.desc: A bottle drainer's Element Filter can be used to designate areas for specific liquid storage.
bottleemptierconduitliquid.effect: Drains bottled Liquids into Liquid Pipes.

bottleemptierconduitgas.name: Canister Drainer
bottleemptierconduitgas.desc: A canister drainer's Element Filter can designate areas for specific gas storage.
bottleemptierconduitgas.effect: Drains Gas canisters into Gas Pipes.

artifactcargobay.name: Artifact Transport Module
artifactcargobay.effect:
Allows Duplicants to store any artifacts they uncover during space missions.

Artifacts become available to the colony upon the rocket's return. 

Must be built via Rocket Platform.

cargobay.name: Cargo Bay
cargobay.desc: Duplicants will fill cargo bays with any resources they find during space missions.
cargobay.effect:
Allows Duplicants to store any Solid Materials found during space missions.

Stored resources become available to the colony upon the rocket's return.

cargobaycluster.name: Large Cargo Bay
cargobaycluster.desc: Holds more than a regular cargo bay.
cargobaycluster.effect:
Allows Duplicants to store most of the Solid Materials found during space missions.

Stored resources become available to the colony upon the rocket's return. 

Must be built via Rocket Platform.

solidcargobaysmall.name: Cargo Bay
solidcargobaysmall.desc: Duplicants will fill cargo bays with any resources they find during space missions.
solidcargobaysmall.effect:
Allows Duplicants to store some of the Solid Materials found during space missions.

Stored resources become available to the colony upon the rocket's return. 

Must be built via Rocket Platform.

specialcargobay.name: Biological Cargo Bay
specialcargobay.desc: Biological cargo bays allow Duplicants to retrieve alien plants and wildlife from space.
specialcargobay.effect:
Allows Duplicants to store unusual or organic resources found during space missions.

Stored resources become available to the colony upon the rocket's return.

specialcargobaycluster.name: Critter Cargo Bay
specialcargobaycluster.desc: Critters do not require feeding during transit.
specialcargobaycluster.effect:
Allows Duplicants to transport Critters through space.

Specimens can be released into the colony upon the rocket's return.

Must be built via Rocket Platform.

commandmodule.name: Command Capsule
commandmodule.desc: At least one astronaut must be assigned to the command module to pilot a rocket.
commandmodule.effect:
Contains passenger seating for Duplicant Astronauts.

A Command Capsule must be the last module installed at the top of a rocket.
commandmodule.logic_port_ready_active: Sends a Green Signal when its rocket launch checklist is complete

clustercommandmodule.name: Command Capsule
clustercommandmodule.logic_port_ready_active: Sends a Green Signal when its rocket launch checklist is complete

clustercraftinteriordoor.name: Interior Hatch
clustercraftinteriordoor.desc: A hatch for getting in and out of the rocket.

robopilotmodule.name: Robo-Pilot Module
robopilotmodule.desc: Robo-pilot modules do not require a Duplicant astronaut.
robopilotmodule.effect:
Enables rockets to travel swfitly without a Rocket Control Station.

Must be built via Rocket Platform.

robopilotcommandmodule.name: Robo-Pilot Capsule
robopilotcommandmodule.desc: Robo-pilot modules do not require a Duplicant astronaut.
robopilotcommandmodule.effect:
Enables rockets to travel swiftly and safely without a Command Capsule.

A Robo-Pilot Capsule must be the last module installed at the top of a rocket.

rocketcontrolstation.name: Rocket Control Station
rocketcontrolstation.desc: Someone needs to be around to jiggle the controls when the screensaver comes on.
rocketcontrolstation.effect:
Allows Duplicants to use pilot-operated rockets and control access to interior buildings.

Assigned Duplicants must have the Rocket Piloting skill.
rocketcontrolstation.logic_port_active: Green Signal: Restrict access to interior buildings
rocketcontrolstation.logic_port_inactive: Red Signal: Unrestrict access to interior buildings

researchmodule.name: Research Module
researchmodule.desc: Data banks can be used at virtual planetariums to produce additional research.
researchmodule.effect:
Completes one Research Task per space mission.

Produces a small Data Bank regardless of mission destination.

Generated Research Points become available upon the rocket's return.

researchclustermodule.name: Research Module
researchclustermodule.desc: Unlocks the possibility of Gathering Databanks floating in space
researchclustermodule.effect: The Research module allows the rocket to gather Data banks that happen to be on the same hex cell than the rocket when it travels through the galaxy

touristmodule.name: Sight-Seeing Module
touristmodule.desc: An astronaut must accompany sight seeing Duplicants on rocket flights.
touristmodule.effect:
Allows one non-Astronaut Duplicant to visit space.

Sight-Seeing Rocket flights decrease Stress.

scannermodule.name: Cartographic Module
scannermodule.desc: Allows Duplicants to boldly go where other Duplicants haven't been yet.
scannermodule.effect:
Automatically analyzes adjacent space while on a voyage. 

Must be built via Rocket Platform.

habitatmodulesmall.name: Solo Spacefarer Nosecone
habitatmodulesmall.desc: One lucky Duplicant gets the best view from the whole rocket.
habitatmodulesmall.effect:
Functions as a Command Module and a Nosecone.

Holds one Duplicant traveller.

One Command Module may be installed per rocket.

Must be built via Rocket Platform. 

Must be built at the top of a rocket.

habitatmodulemedium.name: Spacefarer Module
habitatmodulemedium.desc: Allows Duplicants to survive space travel... Hopefully.
habitatmodulemedium.effect:
Functions as a Command Module.

Holds up to 10 Duplicant travellers.

One Command Module may be installed per rocket. 

Must be built via Rocket Platform.

noseconebasic.name: Basic Nosecone
noseconebasic.desc: Every rocket requires a nosecone to fly.
noseconebasic.effect:
Protects a rocket during takeoff and entry, enabling space travel.

Must be built via Rocket Platform, and built at the top of a rocket.

noseconeharvest.name: Drillcone
noseconeharvest.desc: Collecting the drilled-out resources requires a storage module.
noseconeharvest.effect:
Enables a rocket to drill into interstellar debris to free up gas, liquid and solid resources in space.

Engine must be built via Rocket Platform. 

Must be built at the top of a rocket with gas, liquid or solid Cargo Module attached to store the appropriate resources.

co2engine.name: Carbon Dioxide Engine
co2engine.desc: Rockets can be used to send Duplicants into space and retrieve rare resources.
co2engine.effect:
Uses pressurized Carbon Dioxide to propel rockets for short range space exploration.

Carbon Dioxide Engines are relatively fast engine for their size but with limited height restrictions.

Engine must be built via Rocket Platform. 

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

keroseneengine.name: Petroleum Engine
keroseneengine.desc: Rockets can be used to send Duplicants into space and retrieve rare resources.
keroseneengine.effect:
Burns Petroleum to propel rockets for mid-range space exploration.

Petroleum Engines have generous height restrictions, ideal for hauling many modules.

The engine must be built first before more rocket modules can be added.

keroseneenginecluster.name: Petroleum Engine
keroseneenginecluster.desc: More powerful rocket engines can propel heavier burdens.
keroseneenginecluster.effect:
Burns Petroleum to propel rockets for mid-range space exploration.

Petroleum Engines have generous height restrictions, ideal for hauling many modules.

Engine must be built via Rocket Platform, and requires an oxidizer tank. 

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

keroseneengineclustersmall.name: Small Petroleum Engine
keroseneengineclustersmall.desc: Rockets can be used to send Duplicants into space and retrieve rare resources.
keroseneengineclustersmall.effect:
Burns Petroleum to propel rockets for mid-range space exploration.

Small Petroleum Engines possess the same speed as a Petroleum Engines but have smaller height restrictions.

Engine must be built via Rocket Platform, and requires an oxidizer tank.

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

biodieselengine.name: Biodiesel Engine
biodieselengine.desc: Rockets can be used to send Duplicants into space and retrieve rare resources.
biodieselengine.effect:
Burns Biodiesel to propel rockets for mid-range space exploration.

Biodiesel Engines have generous height restrictions, ideal for hauling a larger number of modules.

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

biodieselenginecluster.name: Biodiesel Engine
biodieselenginecluster.desc: More powerful rocket engines can propel heavier burdens.
biodieselenginecluster.effect:
Burns Biodiesel to propel rockets for mid-range space exploration.

Biodiesel Engines have generous height restrictions, ideal for hauling many modules.

Engine must be built via Rocket Platform, and requires an oxidizer tank.

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

hydrogenengine.name: Hydrogen Engine
hydrogenengine.desc: Hydrogen engines can propel rockets further than steam or petroleum engines.
hydrogenengine.effect:
Burns Liquid Hydrogen to propel rockets for long-range space exploration.

Hydrogen Engines have the same generous height restrictions as Petroleum Engines but are slightly faster.

The engine must be built first before more rocket modules can be added.

hydrogenenginecluster.name: Hydrogen Engine
hydrogenenginecluster.desc: Hydrogen engines can propel rockets further than steam or petroleum engines.
hydrogenenginecluster.effect:
Burns Liquid Hydrogen to propel rockets for long-range space exploration.

Hydrogen Engines have the same generous height restrictions as Petroleum Engines but are slightly faster.

Engine must be built via Rocket Platform, and requires an oxidizer tank.

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

sugarengine.name: Sugar Engine
sugarengine.desc: Not the most stylish way to travel space, but certainly the tastiest.
sugarengine.effect:
Burns Sucrose to propel rockets for short range space exploration.

Sugar Engines have higher height restrictions than Carbon Dioxide Engines, but move slower.

Engine must be built via Rocket Platform, and requires a Large Solid Oxidizer Tank. 

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

hepengine.name: Radbolt Engine
hepengine.desc: Radbolt-fueled rockets support few modules, but travel exceptionally far.
hepengine.effect:
Injects Radbolts into a reaction chamber to propel rockets for long-range space exploration.

Radbolt Engines are faster than Hydrogen Engines but with a more restrictive height allowance.

Engine must be built via Rocket Platform. 

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.
hepengine.logic_port_storage_active: Sends a Green Signal when its Radbolt Storage is full

orbitalcargomodule.name: Orbital Cargo Module
orbitalcargomodule.desc: It's a generally good idea to pack some supplies when exploring unknown worlds.
orbitalcargomodule.effect:
Delivers cargo to the surface of Planetoids that do not yet have a Rocket Platform. 

Must be built via Rocket Platform.

batterymodule.name: Battery Module
batterymodule.desc: Charging a battery module before takeoff makes it easier to power buildings during flight.
batterymodule.effect:
Stores the excess Power generated by a Rocket Engine or Rocket Platform.

Provides stored power to Interior Rocket Outlets.

Loses charge over time. 

Must be built via Rocket Platform.

pioneermodule.name: Trailblazer Module
pioneermodule.desc: That's one small step for Dupekind.
pioneermodule.effect:
Enables travel to Planetoids that do not yet have a Rocket Platform.

Can hold one Duplicant traveller.

Deployment is available while in a Starmap hex adjacent to a Planetoid. 

Must be built via Rocket Platform.

solarpanelmodule.name: Solar Panel Module
solarpanelmodule.desc: Collect solar energy before takeoff and during flight.
solarpanelmodule.effect:
Converts Sunlight into electrical Power for use on rockets.

Must be built via Rocket Platform. 

Must be exposed to space.

scoutmodule.name: Rover's Module
scoutmodule.desc: Rover can conduct explorations of planetoids that don't have rocket platforms built.
scoutmodule.effect:
Deploys one Rover Bot for remote Planetoid exploration.

Deployment is available while in a Starmap hex adjacent to a Planetoid. 

Must be built via Rocket Platform.

pioneerlander.name: Trailblazer Lander
pioneerlander.desc: Lands a Duplicant on a Planetoid from an orbiting Trailblazer Module.

scoutlander.name: Rover's Lander
scoutlander.desc: Lands Rover on a Planetoid when Rover's Module is in orbit.

gantry.name: Gantry
gantry.desc: A gantry can be built over rocket pieces where ladders and tile cannot.
gantry.effect: Provides scaffolding across rocket modules to allow Duplicant access.
gantry.logic_port_active: Extends gantry when a Green Signal signal is received
gantry.logic_port_inactive: Retracts gantry when a Red Signal signal is received

rocketinteriorpowerplug.name: Power Outlet Fitting
rocketinteriorpowerplug.desc: Outlets conveniently power buildings inside a cockpit using their rocket's power stores.
rocketinteriorpowerplug.effect:
Provides Power to connected buildings.

Pulls power from Battery Modules and Rocket Engines.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.

rocketinteriorliquidinput.name: Liquid Intake Fitting
rocketinteriorliquidinput.effect:
Allows Liquids to be pumped into rocket storage via Pipes.

Sends liquid to the first Rocket Module with available space.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.

rocketinteriorliquidoutput.name: Liquid Output Fitting
rocketinteriorliquidoutput.desc: Now if only we had some water balloons...
rocketinteriorliquidoutput.effect:
Allows Liquids to be drawn from rocket storage via Pipes.

Draws liquid from the first Rocket Module with the requested material.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.

rocketinteriorgasinput.name: Gas Intake Fitting
rocketinteriorgasinput.effect:
Allows Gases to be pumped into rocket storage via Pipes.

Sends gas to the first Rocket Module with available space.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.

rocketinteriorgasoutput.name: Gas Output Fitting
rocketinteriorgasoutput.effect:
Allows Gases to be drawn from rocket storage via Pipes.

Draws gas from the first Rocket Module with the requested material.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.

rocketinteriorsolidinput.name: Conveyor Receptacle Fitting
rocketinteriorsolidinput.desc: Why organize your shelves when you can just shove everything in here?
rocketinteriorsolidinput.effect:
Allows Solid Materials to be moved into rocket storage via Conveyor Rails.

Sends solid material to the first Rocket Module with available space.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.

rocketinteriorsolidoutput.name: Conveyor Loader Fitting
rocketinteriorsolidoutput.desc: For accessing your stored luggage mid-flight.
rocketinteriorsolidoutput.effect:
Allows Solid Materials to be moved out of rocket storage via Conveyor Rails.

Draws solid material from the first Rocket Module with the requested material.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.

watercooler.name: Water Cooler
watercooler.desc: Chatting with friends improves Duplicants' moods and reduces their stress.
watercooler.effect:
Provides a gathering place for Duplicants during Downtime.

Improves Duplicant Morale.

round_body.name: Elegant Water Cooler
round_body.desc: It really classes up a breakroom.

yellow_tartar.name: Ick Yellow Water Cooler
yellow_tartar.desc: Did someone boil eggs in this water?

red_rose.name: Puce Pink Water Cooler
red_rose.desc: Rose-colored paper cups: the shatter-proof alternative to rose-colored glasses.

green_mush.name: Mush Green Water Cooler
green_mush.desc: Ideal for post-Mush Bar palate cleansing.

purple_brainfat.name: Faint Purple Water Cooler
purple_brainfat.desc: Most Duplicants agree that it really should dispense juice.

arcademachine.name: Arcade Cabinet
arcademachine.desc:
Komet Kablam-O!
For up to two players.
arcademachine.effect:
Allows Duplicants to play video games on their breaks.

Increases Duplicant Morale.

singleplayerarcade.name: Single Player Arcade
singleplayerarcade.desc: Space Brawler IV! For one player.
singleplayerarcade.effect:
Allows a Duplicant to play video games solo on their breaks.

Increases Duplicant Morale.

phonobox.name: Jukebot
phonobox.desc: Dancing helps Duplicants get their innermost feelings out.
phonobox.effect:
Plays music for Duplicants to dance to on their breaks.

Increases Duplicant Morale.

juicer.name: Juicer
juicer.desc: Fruity juice can really brighten a Duplicant's breaktime
juicer.effect:
Provides refreshment for Duplicants on their breaks.

Drinking juice increases Duplicant Morale.

espressomachine.name: Espresso Machine
espressomachine.desc: A shot of espresso helps Duplicants relax after a long day.
espressomachine.effect:
Provides refreshment for Duplicants on their breaks.

Increases Duplicant Morale.

telephone.name: Party Line Phone
telephone.desc: You never know who you'll meet on the other line.
telephone.effect:
Can be used by one Duplicant to chat with themselves or with other Duplicants in different locations.

Chatting increases Duplicant Morale.
telephone.effect_babble_tooltip: Duplicants will gain {amount} {attrib} if they chat only with themselves.
telephone.effect_chat_tooltip: Duplicants will gain {amount} {attrib} if they chat with at least one other Duplicant.
telephone.effect_long_distance_tooltip: Duplicants will gain {amount} {attrib} if they chat with at least one other Duplicant across space.

modularliquidinput.name: Liquid Input Hub
modularliquidinput.desc: A hub from which to input Liquids.

modularsolidinput.name: Solid Input Hub
modularsolidinput.desc: A hub from which to input Solids.

modulargasinput.name: Gas Input Hub
modulargasinput.desc: A hub from which to input Gas.

mechanicalsurfboard.name: Mechanical Surfboard
mechanicalsurfboard.desc: Mechanical waves make for radical relaxation time.
mechanicalsurfboard.effect:
Increases Duplicant Morale.

Some Water gets splashed on the floor during use.
mechanicalsurfboard.water_requirement_tooltip: This building must be filled with {amount} {element} in order to function.
mechanicalsurfboard.leak_requirement_tooltip: This building will spill {amount} of its contents on to the floor during use, which must be replenished.

sauna.name: Sauna
sauna.desc: A steamy sauna soothes away all the aches and pains.
sauna.effect:
Uses Steam to create a relaxing atmosphere.

Increases Duplicant Morale and provides a lingering sense of warmth.

beachchair.name: Beach Chair
beachchair.desc: Soak up some relaxing sun rays.
beachchair.effect:
Duplicants can relax by lounging in Sunlight.

Increases Duplicant Morale.
beachchair.lighteffect_low_tooltip: Duplicants will gain {amount} {attrib} if this building is in light dimmer than {lux}.
beachchair.lighteffect_high_tooltip: Duplicants will gain {amount} {attrib} if this building is in at least {lux} light.

sunlamp.name: Sun Lamp
sunlamp.effect:
Gives off Sunlight level Lux.

Can be paired with Beach Chairs.

verticalwindtunnel.name: Vertical Wind Tunnel
verticalwindtunnel.desc: Duplicants love the feeling of high-powered wind through their hair.
verticalwindtunnel.effect:
Must be connected to a Power Source. To properly function, the area under this building must be left vacant.

Increases Duplicants Morale.
verticalwindtunnel.displacementeffect_tooltip: This building will displace {amount} Gas while in use.

teleportalpad.name: Teleporter Pad
teleportalpad.desc: Duplicants are just atoms as far as the pad's concerned.
teleportalpad.effect: Instantly transports Duplicants and items to another portal with the same portal code.

checkpoint.name: Duplicant Checkpoint
checkpoint.desc: Checkpoints can be connected to automated sensors to determine when it's safe to enter.
checkpoint.effect:
Allows Duplicants to pass when receiving a Green Signal.

Prevents Duplicants from passing when receiving a Red Signal.

firepole.name: Fire Pole
firepole.desc: Build these in addition to ladders for efficient upward and downward movement.
firepole.effect:
Allows rapid Duplicant descent.

Significantly slows upward climbing.

floorswitch.name: Weight Plate
floorswitch.desc: Weight plates can be used to turn on amenities only when Duplicants pass by.
floorswitch.effect:
Sends a Green Signal when an object or Duplicant is placed atop of it.

Cannot be triggered by Gas or Liquids.

kiln.name: Kiln
kiln.effect:
Fires Clay to produce Ceramic, and Coal or Wood to produce Refined Carbon.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

liquidfueltank.name: Liquid Fuel Tank
liquidfueltank.desc: Storing additional fuel increases the distance a rocket can travel before returning.
liquidfueltank.effect:
Stores the Liquid fuel piped into it to supply rocket engines.

The stored fuel type is determined by the rocket engine it is built upon.

liquidfueltankcluster.name: Large Liquid Fuel Tank
liquidfueltankcluster.desc: Storing additional fuel increases the distance a rocket can travel before returning.
liquidfueltankcluster.effect:
Stores the Liquid fuel piped into it to supply rocket engines.

The stored fuel type is determined by the rocket engine it is built upon. 

Must be built via Rocket Platform.

landing_pod.name: Spacefarer Deploy Pod
landing_pod.effect:
Contains a Duplicant deployed from orbit.

Pod will disintegrate on arrival.

rocketpod.name: Trailblazer Deploy Pod
rocketpod.desc: The Duplicant inside is equal parts nervous and excited.
rocketpod.effect:
Contains a Duplicant deployed from orbit by a Trailblazer Module.

Contains a Rover deployed from an orbiting Rover's Module.

rocketenvelopewindowtile.name: Rocket Window

Stores Liquid Oxygen for burning rocket fuels.

Must be built via Rocket Platform.

luxurybed.name: Comfy Bed

grandprix.name: Grand Prix Bed
grandprix.desc: Where every Duplicant wakes up a winner.

rocket_bed.name: S.S. Napmaster Bed

bouncy_bed.name: Bouncy Castle Bed
bouncy_bed.desc: An inflatable party prop makes a surprisingly good bed.

puft_bed.name: Puft Bed
puft_bed.desc: A comfy, if somewhat 'fragrant', place to sleep.

hand.name: Cradled Bed
hand.desc: It's so nice to be held.

rubiks.name: Puzzle Cube Bed
rubiks.desc: A little pattern recognition at bedtime soothes the mind.

red_rose.name: Comfy Puce Bed
red_rose.desc: A pink-hued bed for rosy dreams.

green_mush.name: Comfy Mush Bed
green_mush.desc: The mattress is so soft, it's almost impossible to climb out of.

yellow_tartar.name: Comfy Ick Bed

purple_brainfat.name: Comfy Fainting Bed
purple_brainfat.desc: A soft landing spot for swooners.

Provides a sleeping area for one Duplicant and also functions as a ladder.

medicalcot.name: Triage Cot

doctorstation.name: Sick Bay

Allows Duplicants to administer powerful treatments to sick Duplicants.

Duplicants must possess the Advanced Medical Care Skill to treat peers.

massagetable.name: Massage Table

Rapidly reduces Stress for the Duplicant user.

default_massagetable.name: Massage Table

default_ceilinglight.name: Ceiling Light
default_ceilinglight.desc: It does not go on the floor.

labflask.name: Lab Flask Ceiling Light

fauxpipe.name: Faux Pipe Ceiling Light

rubiks.name: Puzzle Cube Ceiling Light

art_tall_a.name: Ode to O2

Can be rotated before construction.

Runs one Gas Pipe section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

liquidconduitpreferentialflow.name: Priority Liquid Flow

Automatically links up to Rocket Ports built to either side of the platform.
launchpad.logic_port_ready_active: Sends a Green Signal when its rocket is ready for flight
launchpad.logic_port_landed_rocket_active: Sends a Green Signal when its rocket is on the Rocket Platform

Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Draws in Gas and runs it through Pipes.

Must be immersed in Gas.

gasminipump.effect:
Draws in a small amount of Gas and runs it through Pipes.

Must be immersed in Gas.

gasbottler.name: Canister Filler
gasbottler.desc: Canisters allow Duplicants to manually deliver gases from place to place.
gasbottler.effect: Automatically stores piped Gases into canisters for manual transport.

liquidbottler.name: Bottle Filler
liquidbottler.desc: Bottle fillers allow Duplicants to manually deliver liquids from place to place.
liquidbottler.effect: Automatically stores piped Liquids into bottles for manual transport.

generator.name: Coal Generator
generator.desc: Burning coal produces more energy than manual power, but emits heat and exhaust.
generator.effect:
Converts Coal into electrical Power.

Produces Carbon Dioxide.

geneticanalysisstation.name: Botanical Analyzer
geneticanalysisstation.desc: Would a mutated rose still smell as sweet?

devgenerator.name: Dev Generator
devgenerator.effect: Generates testing power for late nights.

devlightgenerator.name: Dev Light Source
devlightgenerator.desc: Brightens up a dev's darkest hours.

devradiationgenerator.name: Dev Radiation Emitter
devradiationgenerator.effect: Generates on-demand radiation to keep things clear. Nu-clear.

devheater.name: Dev Heater
devheater.effect: Generates on-demand heat for testing toastiness.

genericfabricator.name: Omniprinter
genericfabricator.desc: Omniprinters are incapable of printing organic matter.
genericfabricator.effect: Converts Raw Mineral into unique materials and objects.

geotuner.name: Geotuner
geotuner.desc: The targeted geyser receives stored amplification data when it is erupting.
geotuner.effect:
Increases the Temperature and output of an analyzed Geyser.

Multiple Geotuners can be directed at a single Geyser anywhere on an asteroid.
geotuner.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal when geyser is erupting

grave.name: Tasteful Memorial
grave.desc: Burying dead Duplicants reduces health hazards and stress on the colony.
grave.effect:
Provides a final resting place for deceased Duplicants.

Living Duplicants will automatically place an unburied corpse inside.

headquarters.name: Printing Pod
headquarters.desc: New Duplicants come out here, but thank goodness, they never go back in.
headquarters.effect:
An exceptionally advanced bioprinter of unknown origin.

It periodically produces new Duplicants or care packages containing resources.

hydrogengenerator.name: Hydrogen Generator
hydrogengenerator.desc: Hydrogen generators are extremely efficient, emitting next to no waste.
hydrogengenerator.effect: Converts Hydrogen Gas into electrical Power.

methanegenerator.name: Natural Gas Generator
methanegenerator.desc: Natural gas generators leak polluted water and are best built above a waste reservoir.
methanegenerator.effect:
Converts Natural Gas into electrical Power.

Produces Carbon Dioxide and Polluted Water.

nuclearreactor.name: Research Reactor
nuclearreactor.desc: Radbolt generators and reflectors make radiation usable by other buildings.
nuclearreactor.effect:
Uses Enriched Uranium to produce Radiation for Radbolt production.

Generates a massive amount of Heat. Overheating will result in an explosive meltdown.

woodgasgenerator.name: Wood Burner
woodgasgenerator.desc: Wood burners are small and easy to maintain, but produce a fair amount of heat.
woodgasgenerator.effect:
Burns Wood to produce electrical Power.

Produces Carbon Dioxide and Heat.

peatgenerator.name: Peat Burner
peatgenerator.desc: It gives off an aroma that some Duplicants find inexplicably nostalgic.
peatgenerator.effect:
Burns Peat to produce electrical Power.

Produces a small amount of Carbon Dioxide and Polluted Water.

fabricatedwoodmaker.name: Plywood Press
fabricatedwoodmaker.desc: Flattened plant bits are a useful wood substitute.
fabricatedwoodmaker.effect: Combines a Binder liquid and Plant Husk to create Plywood.

petroleumgenerator.name: Petroleum Generator
petroleumgenerator.desc: Petroleum generators have a high energy output but produce a great deal of waste.
petroleumgenerator.effect:
Converts Petroleum, Ethanol or Biodiesel into electrical Power.

Produces Carbon Dioxide and Polluted Water.

hydroponicfarm.name: Hydroponic Farm
hydroponicfarm.desc: Hydroponic farms reduce Duplicant traffic by automating irrigating crops.
hydroponicfarm.effect:
Grows one Plant from a Seed.

Can be used as floor tile and rotated before construction.

Must be irrigated through Liquid Piping.

insulatedgasconduit.name: Insulated Gas Pipe
insulatedgasconduit.desc: Pipe insulation prevents gas contents from significantly changing temperature in transit.
insulatedgasconduit.effect:
Carries Gas with minimal change in Temperature.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

gasconduitradiant.name: Radiant Gas Pipe
gasconduitradiant.desc: Radiant pipes pumping cold gas can be run through hot areas to help cool them down.
gasconduitradiant.effect:
Carries Gas, allowing extreme Temperature exchange with the surrounding environment.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

insulatedliquidconduit.name: Insulated Liquid Pipe
insulatedliquidconduit.desc: Pipe insulation prevents liquid contents from significantly changing temperature in transit.
insulatedliquidconduit.effect:
Carries Liquid with minimal change in Temperature.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

liquidconduitradiant.name: Radiant Liquid Pipe
liquidconduitradiant.desc: Radiant pipes pumping cold liquid can be run through hot areas to help cool them down.
liquidconduitradiant.effect:
Carries Liquid, allowing extreme Temperature exchange with the surrounding environment.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

contactconductivepipebridge.name: Conduction Panel
contactconductivepipebridge.desc: It can transfer heat effectively even if no liquid is passing through.
contactconductivepipebridge.effect:
Carries Liquid, allowing extreme Temperature exchange with overlapping buildings.

Can function in a vacuum.

Can be run through wall and floor tiles.

insulatedwire.name: Insulated Wire
insulatedwire.desc: This stuff won't go melting if things get heated.
insulatedwire.effect:
Connects buildings to Power sources in extreme Heat.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

insulationtile.name: Insulated Tile
insulationtile.desc: The low thermal conductivity of insulated tiles slows any heat passing through them.
insulationtile.effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Reduces Heat transfer between walls, retaining ambient heat in an area.

exteriorwall.name: Drywall
exteriorwall.desc: Drywall can be used in conjunction with tiles to build airtight rooms on the surface.
exteriorwall.effect:
Prevents Gas and Liquid loss in space.

Builds an insulating backwall behind buildings.

snow.name: Snowflake Print
snow.desc: A wallpaper as unique as my colony.

basic_white.name: Fresh White
basic_white.desc: It's just so fresh and so clean.

diagonal_red_deep_white.name: Magma Diagonal
diagonal_red_deep_white.desc: A red wallpaper with a diagonal stripe.

diagonal_orange_satsuma_white.name: Bright Diagonal
diagonal_orange_satsuma_white.desc: An orange wallpaper with a diagonal stripe.

diagonal_yellow_lemon_white.name: Yellowcake Diagonal

diagonal_green_kelly_white.name: Algae Diagonal

diagonal_blue_cobalt_white.name: H2O Diagonal

diagonal_pink_flamingo_white.name: Petal Diagonal
diagonal_pink_flamingo_white.desc: A pink wallpaper with a diagonal stripe.

diagonal_grey_charcoal_white.name: Charcoal Diagonal
diagonal_grey_charcoal_white.desc: A sleek wallpaper with a diagonal stripe.

circle_red_deep_white.name: Magma Wedge
circle_red_deep_white.desc: It can be arranged into giant red polka dots.

circle_orange_satsuma_white.name: Bright Wedge

circle_yellow_lemon_white.name: Yellowcake Wedge
circle_yellow_lemon_white.desc: A radiation-free pattern that can be arranged into giant polka dots.

circle_green_kelly_white.name: Algae Wedge

circle_blue_cobalt_white.name: H2O Wedge

circle_pink_flamingo_white.name: Petal Wedge

circle_grey_charcoal_white.name: Charcoal Wedge
circle_grey_charcoal_white.desc: It can be arranged into giant shadowy polka dots.

basic_blue_cobalt.name: Solid Cobalt
basic_blue_cobalt.desc: It doesn't cure the blues, so much as emphasize them.

basic_green_kelly.name: Spring Green
basic_green_kelly.desc: It's cheaper than having a garden.

basic_orange_satsuma.name: Solid Satsuma
basic_orange_satsuma.desc: Less fruit-forward, but just as fresh.

basic_pink_flamingo.name: Solid Pink
basic_pink_flamingo.desc: A bold statement, for bold Duplicants.

basic_red_deep.name: Chili Red
basic_red_deep.desc: It really spices up dull walls.

satsuma.name: Satsuma Slice
satsuma.desc: Adds some much-needed zest to the room.

strawberry.name: Strawberry Speckle
strawberry.desc: Fruity freckles for naturally sweet spaces.

watermelon.name: Juicy Watermelon
watermelon.desc: Far more practical than gluing real fruit on a wall.

tropical.name: Sporechid Print
tropical.desc: The original scratch-and-sniff version was immediately recalled.

toiletpaper.name: De-loo-xe
toiletpaper.desc: Softly undulating lines create an undeniable air of loo-xury.

stripes_blue.name: Blue Awning Stripe
stripes_blue.desc: Thick stripes in alternating shades of blue.

stripes_diagonal_blue.name: Blue Regimental Stripe
stripes_diagonal_blue.desc: Inspired by the ties worn during intraoffice sports.

stripes_circle_blue.name: Blue Circle Stripe
stripes_circle_blue.desc: A stripe that curves to the right.

squares_orange_satsuma_white.name: Bright Checkers
squares_orange_satsuma_white.desc: Every tile feels like four tiles!

squares_yellow_lemon_white.name: Yellowcake Checkers
squares_yellow_lemon_white.desc: Any brighter, and they'd be radioactive!

squares_green_kelly_white.name: Algae Checkers
squares_green_kelly_white.desc: Now with real simulated algae color!

plus_grey_charcoal_white.name: Digital Charcoal
plus_grey_charcoal_white.desc: It's futuristic, so it must be good.

stripes_rose.name: Puce Stripe
stripes_rose.desc: Vertical stripes make it quite obvious when nearby objects are askew.

stripes_diagonal_rose.name: Puce Diagonal
stripes_diagonal_rose.desc: Some describe this color as "squashed bug."

stripes_circle_rose.name: Puce Curves
stripes_circle_rose.desc: It's pronounced "peeyoo-ss," a sound that Duplicants just can't seem to reproduce.

stripes_mush.name: Mush Stripe
stripes_mush.desc: The kind of green that makes one feel slightly nauseated.

stripes_diagonal_mush.name: Mush Diagonal
stripes_diagonal_mush.desc: Diagonal stripes in alternating shades of mush bar.

stripes_circle_mush.name: Mush Curves
stripes_circle_mush.desc: This wallpaper, like this colony's journey, is full of twists and turns.

stripes_yellow_tartar.name: Ick Stripe
stripes_yellow_tartar.desc: Vertical stripes make it quite obvious when nearby objects are askew.

stripes_diagonal_yellow_tartar.name: Ick Diagonal
stripes_diagonal_yellow_tartar.desc: Diagonal stripes in alternating shades of yellow.

stripes_circle_yellow_tartar.name: Ick Curves
stripes_circle_yellow_tartar.desc: This wallpaper, like this colony's journey, is full of twists and turns.

stripes_purple_brainfat.name: Fainting Stripe
stripes_purple_brainfat.desc: Vertical stripes make it quite obvious when nearby objects are askew.

stripes_diagonal_purple_brainfat.name: Fainting Diagonal
stripes_diagonal_purple_brainfat.desc: Diagonal stripes in alternating shades of purple.

stripes_circle_purple_brainfat.name: Fainting Curves
stripes_circle_purple_brainfat.desc: This wallpaper, like this colony's journey, is full of twists and turns.

floppy_azulene_vitro.name: Waterlogged Databank
floppy_azulene_vitro.desc: A fun blue print in honor of information storage.

floppy_black_white.name: Monochrome Databank
floppy_black_white.desc: A chic black-and-white print in honor of information storage.

floppy_peagreen_balmy.name: Lush Databank
floppy_peagreen_balmy.desc: A fun green print in honor of information storage.

floppy_satsuma_yellowcake.name: Hi-Vis Databank
floppy_satsuma_yellowcake.desc: A fun orange print in honor of information storage.

floppy_magma_amino.name: Flashy Databank
floppy_magma_amino.desc: A fun red print in honor of information storage.

orange_juice.name: Infinite Spill
orange_juice.desc: If the liquids never hit the floor, is it really a spill?

paint_blots.name: Happy Accidents
paint_blots.desc: There are no mistakes, only cheerful little splotches.

tictactoe_o.name: TicTacToe O
tictactoe_o.desc: A crisp black 'O' on a clean white background. Ideal for monochromatic games rooms.

tictactoe_x.name: TicTacToe X
tictactoe_x.desc: A crisp black 'X' on a clean white background. Ideal for monochromatic games rooms.

farmtile.name: Farm Tile
farmtile.desc: Duplicants can deliver fertilizer and liquids to farm tiles, accelerating plant growth.
farmtile.effect:
Grows one Plant from a Seed.

Can be used as floor tile and rotated before construction.

ladderfast.name: Plastic Ladder
ladderfast.desc: Plastic ladders are mildly antiseptic and can help limit the spread of germs in a colony.

liquidconduit.name: Liquid Pipe
liquidconduit.desc: Liquid pipes are used to connect the inputs and outputs of plumbed buildings.
liquidconduit.effect:
Carries Liquid between Outputs and Intakes.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

liquidconduitbridge.name: Liquid Bridge
liquidconduitbridge.desc: Separate pipe systems help prevent building damage caused by mingled pipe contents.
liquidconduitbridge.effect:
Runs one Liquid Pipe section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

icecooledfan.name: Ice-E Fan
icecooledfan.desc: A Duplicant can work an Ice-E fan to temporarily cool small areas as needed.
icecooledfan.effect: Uses Ice to dissipate a small amount of the Heat.

icemachine.name: Ice Maker
icemachine.desc: Ice makers can be used as a small renewable source of ice and snow.
icemachine.effect: Converts Water into Ice or Snow.

liquidcooledfan.name: Hydrofan
liquidcooledfan.desc: A Duplicant can work a hydrofan to temporarily cool small areas as needed.
liquidcooledfan.effect: Dissipates a small amount of the Heat.

creaturetrap.name: Critter Trap
creaturetrap.desc: Critter traps cannot catch swimming or flying critters.
creaturetrap.effect:
Captures a living Critter for transport.

Single use.

creaturegroundtrap.name: Critter Trap
creaturegroundtrap.desc: It's designed for land critters, but flopping fish sometimes find their way in too.
creaturegroundtrap.effect:
Captures a living Critter for transport.

Only Duplicants with the Critter Ranching I skill can arm this trap. It's reusable!

creaturedeliverypoint.name: Critter Drop-Off
creaturedeliverypoint.desc: Duplicants automatically bring captured critters to these relocation points for release.
creaturedeliverypoint.effect:
Releases trapped Critters back into the world.

Can be used multiple times.

critterpickup.name: Critter Pick-Up
critterpickup.desc: Duplicants will automatically wrangle excess critters.
critterpickup.effect:
Ensures the prompt relocation of Critters that exceed the maximum amount set.

Monitoring and pick-up are limited to the specified species.

logic_input.logic_port_inactive: LOGIC_PORT_INACTIVE = UI.FormatAsAutomationState("Red Signal", UI.AutomationState.Standby): Ignore excess critters

critterdropoff.name: Critter Drop-Off
critterdropoff.desc: Duplicants automatically bring captured critters to these relocation points for release.
critterdropoff.effect:
Releases trapped Critters back into the world.

Monitoring and drop-off are limited to the specified species.

liquidfilter.name: Liquid Filter
liquidfilter.desc: All liquids are sent into the building's output pipe, except the liquid chosen for filtering.
liquidfilter.effect:
Sieves one Liquid out of a mix, sending it into a dedicated Filtered Output Pipe.

Can only filter one liquid type at a time.

devpumpliquid.name: Dev Pump Liquid
devpumpliquid.desc: Piping a pump's output to a building's intake will send liquid to that building.
devpumpliquid.effect:
Draws in Liquid and runs it through Pipes.

Must be submerged in Liquid.

liquidpump.name: Liquid Pump
liquidpump.desc: Piping a pump's output to a building's intake will send liquid to that building.
liquidpump.effect:
Draws in Liquid and runs it through Pipes.

Must be submerged in Liquid.

liquidminipump.name: Mini Liquid Pump
liquidminipump.desc: Mini pumps are useful for moving small quantities of liquid with minimum power.
liquidminipump.effect:
Draws in a small amount of Liquid and runs it through Pipes.

Must be submerged in Liquid.

liquidpumpingstation.name: Pitcher Pump
liquidpumpingstation.desc: Pitcher pumps allow Duplicants to bottle and deliver liquids from place to place.
liquidpumpingstation.effect:
Manually pumps Liquid into bottles for transport.

Duplicants can only carry liquids that are bottled.

liquidvalve.name: Liquid Valve
liquidvalve.desc: Valves control the amount of liquid that moves through pipes, preventing waste.
liquidvalve.effect: Controls the Liquid volume permitted through Pipes.

liquidlogicvalve.name: Liquid Shutoff
liquidlogicvalve.desc: Automated piping saves power and time by removing the need for Duplicant input.
liquidlogicvalve.effect: Connects to an Automation grid to automatically turn Liquid flow on or off.

liquidlimitvalve.name: Liquid Meter Valve
liquidlimitvalve.desc: Meter Valves let an exact amount of liquid pass through before shutting off.
liquidlimitvalve.effect: Connects to an Automation grid to automatically turn Liquid flow off when the specified amount has passed through it.
liquidlimitvalve.output_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if limit has been reached

liquidvent.name: Liquid Vent
liquidvent.desc: Vents are an exit point for liquids from plumbing systems.

manualgenerator.name: Manual Generator
manualgenerator.desc: Watching Duplicants run on it is adorable... the electrical power is just an added bonus.
manualgenerator.effect: Converts manual labor into electrical Power.

manualpressuredoor.name: Manual Airlock
manualpressuredoor.desc: Airlocks can quarter off dangerous areas and prevent gases from seeping into the colony.
manualpressuredoor.effect:
Blocks Liquid and Gas flow, maintaining pressure between areas.

Wild Critters cannot pass through doors.

meshtile.name: Mesh Tile
meshtile.desc: Mesh tile can be used to make Duplicant pathways in areas where liquid flows.
meshtile.effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Does not obstruct Liquid or Gas flow.

plastictile.name: Plastic Tile
plastictile.desc: Plastic tile is mildly antiseptic and can help limit the spread of germs in a colony.
plastictile.effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Significantly increases Duplicant runspeed.

glasstile.name: Window Tile
glasstile.desc: Window tiles provide a barrier against liquid and gas and are completely transparent.
glasstile.effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Allows Light and Decor to pass through.

metaltile.name: Metal Tile
metaltile.desc: Heat travels much more quickly through metal tile than other types of flooring.
metaltile.effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Significantly increases Duplicant runspeed.

bunkertile.name: Bunker Tile
bunkertile.desc: Bunker tile can build strong shelters in otherwise dangerous environments.
bunkertile.effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Can withstand extreme pressures and impacts.

storagetile.name: Storage Tile
storagetile.desc: Storage tiles keep selected non-edible solids out of the way.
storagetile.effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Provides built-in storage for small spaces.

carpettile.name: Carpeted Tile
carpettile.effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

mouldingtile.name: Trimming Tile
mouldingtile.desc: Trimming is used as purely decorative lining for walls and structures.
mouldingtile.effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

monumentbottom.name: Monument Base
monumentbottom.desc: The base of a monument must be constructed first.
monumentbottom.effect:
Builds the bottom section of a Great Monument.

Can be customized.

A Great Monument must be built to achieve the Colonize Imperative.

option_f.desc: One knee tucked toward the other.

option_h.name: Hatch Hunter
option_h.desc: Atop a pair of conquered critters.

option_k.name: Egg Equanimity
option_k.desc: One must give the soul time to truly hatch.

option_m.name: Sweet Seat
option_m.desc: In honor of the sugar engine.

option_n.desc: Riding a carbon dioxide rocket engine to glory.

option_p.desc: Atop a solo spacefarer rocket nosecone.

option_t.name: Sweepy III
option_t.desc: Atop a happy lil' Sweepy bot.

monumentmiddle.desc: Customized sections of a Great Monument can be mixed and matched.
monumentmiddle.effect:
Builds the middle section of a Great Monument.

Can be customized.

option_d.name: Hands on Hips
option_d.desc: Makes the torso seem bigger and more intimidating than it is.

option_e.name: The Shrug
option_e.desc: Sometimes things are good enough just as they are.

option_k.name: Arms Ajar
option_k.desc: Hands hover slightly away from the body, as though raised in wonder.

option_l.name: Babes in Arms I
option_l.desc: Cradling a couple of smooth lil' critter babies.

option_n.name: Babes in Arms II
option_n.desc: An armful of chonky lil' critter babies.

monumenttop.name: Monument Top
monumenttop.desc: Building a Great Monument will declare to the universe that this hunk of rock is your own.
monumenttop.effect:
Builds the top section of a Great Monument.

Can be customized.

A Great Monument must be built to achieve the Colonize Imperative.

option_a.desc: A massive replica of Leira's smiling face.

option_f.desc: A massive replica of Rowan's serene smile.

option_g.name: Nisbet Noggin
option_g.desc: A massive replica of Nisbet when she sees someone whose name she's forgotten.

option_h.name: Ashkan Noggin
option_h.desc: A massive replica of Ashkan's fossil-discovering expression.

option_i.name: Ren Noggin
option_i.desc: A massive replica of Ren's smoochy face.

option_m.name: Gassy Moo Top
option_m.desc: A great-monument-sized Gassy Moo. Gassier and moo-ier than ever.

option_t.name: Plug Slug Top
option_t.desc: A great-monument-sized Plug Slug. Does not require a power source.

option_v.name: Rover Top
option_v.desc: It has no mouth, but still looks like it's smiling.

option_w.name: Radsick Top I
option_w.desc: A visual reminder about radiation safety.

option_y.name: Radsick Top III
option_y.desc: A cautionary tale for careless Duplicants.

option_z.name: Radsick Top IV
option_z.desc: Excellent choice of decor for the entrance to highly radioactive site.

microbemusher.name: Microbe Musher
microbemusher.desc: Musher recipes will keep Duplicants fed, but may impact health and morale over time.
microbemusher.effect:
Produces low quality Food using common ingredients.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

default_microbemusher.name: Microbe Musher
default_microbemusher.desc: Musher recipes will keep Duplicants fed, but may impact health and morale over time.

purple_brainfat.name: Faint Purple Microbe Musher
purple_brainfat.desc: A colorful distraction from the actual quality of the food.

yellow_tartar.name: Ick Yellow Microbe Musher
yellow_tartar.desc: Makes meals that are memorable for all the wrong reasons.

red_rose.name: Puce Pink Microbe Musher
red_rose.desc: Hunger strikes are not an option, but color-coordination is.

mineraldeoxidizer.name: Oxygen Diffuser
mineraldeoxidizer.desc: Oxygen diffusers are inefficient, but output enough oxygen to keep a colony breathing.
mineraldeoxidizer.effect:
Converts large amounts of Algae into Oxygen.

Becomes idle when the area reaches maximum pressure capacity.

sublimationstation.name: Sublimation Station
sublimationstation.desc: Sublimation is the sublime process by which solids convert directly into gas.
sublimationstation.effect:
Speeds up the conversion of Polluted Dirt into Polluted Oxygen.

Becomes idle when the area reaches maximum pressure capacity.

woodtile.name: Wood Tile
woodtile.desc: Rooms built with wood tile are cozy and pleasant.
woodtile.effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Provides good insulation and boosts Decor, contributing to Morale.

snowtile.name: Snow Tile
snowtile.desc: Snow tiles have low thermal conductivity, but will melt if temperatures get too high.
snowtile.effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Insulates rooms to reduce Heat loss in cold climates.

campfire.name: Wood Heater
campfire.desc: Wood heaters dry out soggy feet and help Duplicants forget how cold they are.
campfire.effect: Consumes Wood in order to Heat chilly surroundings.

icekettle.name: Ice Liquefier
icekettle.desc: The water never gets hot enough to burn the tongue.
icekettle.effect: Consumes Wood to melt Ice into Water, which can be bottled for transport.

woodstorage.name: Wood Pile
woodstorage.desc: Once it's empty, there's no use pining for more.
woodstorage.effect: Stores a finite supply of Wood, which can be used for construction or to produce Heat.

dlc2poitechunlocks.name: Research Portal
dlc2poitechunlocks.desc:
A functional research decrypter with one transmission remaining.

It was designed to support colony survival.

dlc4poitechunlocks.name: Research Portal
dlc4poitechunlocks.desc:
A functional research decrypter with one transmission remaining.

It was designed to support colony survival.

deepfryer.name: Deep Fryer
deepfryer.desc: Everything tastes better when it's deep-fried.
deepfryer.effect:
Uses Tallow to cook a wide variety of improved Foods.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

outside_kitchen.name: Outside of Kitchen
outside_kitchen.tooltip: This building must be in a Kitchen before it can be used

orescrubber.name: Ore Scrubber
orescrubber.desc: Scrubbers sanitize freshly mined materials before they're brought into the colony.
orescrubber.effect: Kills a significant amount of Germs present on Raw Ore.

outhouse.name: Outhouse
outhouse.desc: The colony that eats together, excretes together.
outhouse.effect:
Gives Duplicants a place to relieve themselves.

Requires no Piping.

Must be periodically emptied of Polluted Dirt.

apothecary.name: Apothecary
apothecary.desc: Some medications help prevent diseases, while others aim to alleviate existing illness.
apothecary.effect:
Produces Medicine to cure most basic Diseases.

Duplicants must possess the Medicine Compounding Skill to fabricate medicines.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

advancedapothecary.name: Nuclear Apothecary
advancedapothecary.desc: Some medications help prevent diseases, while others aim to alleviate existing illness.
advancedapothecary.effect:
Produces Medicine to cure most basic Diseases.

Duplicants must possess the Medicine Compounding Skill to fabricate medicines.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

planterbox.name: Planter Box
planterbox.desc: Domestically grown seeds mature more quickly than wild plants.
planterbox.effect: Grows one Plant from a Seed.

default_planterbox.name: Planter Box
default_planterbox.desc: Domestically grown seeds mature more quickly than wild plants.

bristleblossom.name: Bristly Green Planter Box
bristleblossom.desc: The interior is lined with tiny barbs.

sleetwheat.name: Sleet Blue Planter Box
sleetwheat.desc: The thick paint drips are invisible from a distance.

salmon_pink.name: Flashy Planter Box
salmon_pink.desc: It's not exactly a subtle color.

pressuredoor.name: Mechanized Airlock
pressuredoor.desc: Mechanized airlocks open and close more quickly than other types of door.
pressuredoor.effect:
Blocks Liquid and Gas flow, maintaining pressure between areas.

Functions as a Manual Airlock when no Power is available.

Wild Critters cannot pass through doors.

bunkerdoor.name: Bunker Door
bunkerdoor.desc: A massive, slow-moving door which is nearly indestructible.
bunkerdoor.effect:
Blocks Liquid and Gas flow, maintaining pressure between areas.

Can withstand extremely high pressures and impacts.

insulateddoor.name: Insulated Door
insulateddoor.desc: A slow-moving door that works best when it's closed.
insulateddoor.effect: Significantly reduces Temperature exchange between climate-controlled rooms.

woodendoor.name: Wicker Door
woodendoor.desc: A breezy wooden door combines style and function.
woodendoor.effect:
Encloses areas without blocking Liquid or Gas flow.

Wild Critters cannot pass through doors.

rationbox.name: Ration Box
rationbox.desc: Ration boxes keep food safe from hungry critters, but don't slow food spoilage.
rationbox.effect:
Stores a small amount of Food.

Food must be delivered to boxes by Duplicants.

parksign.name: Park Sign
parksign.desc: Passing through parks will increase Duplicant Morale.
parksign.effect: Classifies an area as a Park or Nature Reserve.

radiationlight.name: Radiation Lamp
radiationlight.desc: Duplicants can become sick if exposed to radiation without protection.
radiationlight.effect: Emits Radiation when Powered that can be collected by a Radbolt Generator.

refrigerator.name: Refrigerator
refrigerator.desc: Food spoilage can be slowed by ambient conditions as well as by refrigerators.
refrigerator.effect: Stores Food at an ideal Temperature to prevent spoilage.
refrigerator.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal when full

default_refrigerator.name: Refrigerator
default_refrigerator.desc: Food spoilage can be slowed by ambient conditions as well as by refrigerators.

stripes_red_white.name: Bold Stripe Refrigerator
stripes_red_white.desc: Bold on the outside, cold on the inside!

blue_babytears.name: Weepy Blue Refrigerator
blue_babytears.desc: For food so cold, it brings a tear to the eye.

green_mush.name: Mush Green Refrigerator
green_mush.desc: Honestly, this hue is particularly chilling.

red_rose.name: Puce Pink Refrigerator
red_rose.desc: Inspired by the Duplicant poem, "Pretty in Puce."

yellow_tartar.name: Ick Yellow Refrigerator
yellow_tartar.desc: Some Duplicants call it "sunny" yellow, but only because they've never seen the sun.

purple_brainfat.name: Faint Purple Refrigerator
purple_brainfat.desc: This fridge makes color-coordination a (cold) snap.

rolestation.name: Skills Board
rolestation.desc: A skills board can teach special skills to Duplicants they can't learn on their own.
rolestation.effect: Allows Duplicants to spend Skill Points to learn new Skills.

resetskillsstation.name: Skill Scrubber
resetskillsstation.desc: Erase skills from a Duplicant's mind, returning them to their default abilities.
resetskillsstation.effect:
Refunds a Duplicant's Skill Points for reassignment.

Duplicants will lose all assigned skills in the process.

researchcenter.name: Research Station
researchcenter.desc: Research stations are necessary for unlocking all research tiers.
researchcenter.effect:
Conducts Novice Research to unlock new technologies.

Consumes Dirt.

advancedresearchcenter.name: Super Computer
advancedresearchcenter.desc: Super computers unlock higher technology tiers than research stations alone.
advancedresearchcenter.effect:
Conducts Advanced Research to unlock new technologies.

Consumes Water.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the Advanced Research skill.

nuclearresearchcenter.name: Materials Study Terminal
nuclearresearchcenter.desc: Comes with a few ions thrown in, free of charge.
nuclearresearchcenter.effect:
Conducts Materials Science Research to unlock new technologies.

Consumes Radbolts.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the Applied Sciences Research skill.

orbitalresearchcenter.name: Orbital Data Collection Lab
orbitalresearchcenter.desc: Orbital Data Collection Labs record data while orbiting a Planetoid and write it to a Data Bank.
orbitalresearchcenter.effect:
Creates Data Banks that can be consumed at a Virtual Planetarium to unlock new technologies.

Consumes Plastic and Power.

cosmicresearchcenter.name: Virtual Planetarium
cosmicresearchcenter.desc: Planetariums allow the simulated exploration of locations discovered with a telescope.
cosmicresearchcenter.effect:
Conducts Interstellar Research to unlock new technologies.

Consumes data from Research Modules.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the Astronomy skill.

dlc1cosmicresearchcenter.name: Virtual Planetarium
dlc1cosmicresearchcenter.desc: Planetariums allow the simulated exploration of locations recorded in Data Banks.
dlc1cosmicresearchcenter.effect:
Conducts Data Analysis Research to unlock new technologies.

Consumes Data Banks generated by exploration.

telescope.name: Telescope
telescope.desc: Telescopes are necessary for learning starmaps and conducting rocket missions.
telescope.effect:
Maps Starmap destinations for space exploration.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the Field Research skill.

Building must be exposed to space to function.
telescope.requirement_tooltip: A steady {0} supply is required to sustain working Duplicants.

clustertelescope.name: Telescope
clustertelescope.desc: Telescopes are necessary for studying space, allowing rocket travel to other worlds.
clustertelescope.effect:
Reveals visitable Planetoids in space, producing Data Banks in the process.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the Astronomy skill.

Building must be exposed to space to function.
clustertelescope.requirement_tooltip: A steady {0} supply is required to sustain working Duplicants.

clustertelescopeenclosed.name: Enclosed Telescope
clustertelescopeenclosed.desc: It's easier to focus on work when shielded from the vacuum of space.
clustertelescopeenclosed.effect:
Reveals visitable Planetoids in space and produces Data Banks... in comfort!

Assigned Duplicants must possess the Astronomy skill.

Excellent sunburn protection (100%), partial Radiation protection (FIXEDTRAITS.COSMICRADIATION.TELESCOPE_RADIATION_SHIELDING * 100f) .

Building must be exposed to space to function.
clustertelescopeenclosed.requirement_tooltip: A steady {0} supply is required to sustain working Duplicants.

missioncontrol.name: Mission Control Station
missioncontrol.desc: Like a backseat driver who actually does know better.
missioncontrol.effect:
Provides guidance data to rocket pilots, to improve rocket speed.

Must be operated by a Duplicant with the Astronomy skill.

Requires a clear line of sight to space in order to function.

missioncontrolcluster.name: Mission Control Station
missioncontrolcluster.desc: Like a backseat driver who actually does know better.
missioncontrolcluster.effect:
Provides guidance data to rocket pilots within range, to improve rocket speed.

Must be operated by a Duplicant with the Astronomy skill.

Requires a clear line of sight to space in order to function.

sculpture.name: Large Sculpting Block
sculpture.desc: Duplicants who have learned art skills can produce more decorative sculptures.
sculpture.effect:
Moderately increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

sculpture_good_1.desc: Ode to the bow and arrow, love's equivalent to a mining gun...but for hearts.

sculpture_amazing_2.name: Plate Chucker
sculpture_amazing_2.desc: A masterful portrayal of an athlete who's been banned from the communal kitchen.

sculpture_amazing_3.name: Before Battle
sculpture_amazing_3.desc: A masterful portrayal of a slingshot-wielding hero.

sculpture_amazing_4.name: Grandiose Grub-Grub
sculpture_amazing_4.desc: A masterful portrayal of a gentle, plant-tending critter.

sculpture_amazing_1.desc: A masterful portrayal of a scientist lost in thought.

sculpture_amazing_6.name: Into the Voids
sculpture_amazing_6.desc: No amount of material success will ever fill the void within.

icesculpture.name: Ice Block
icesculpture.effect:
Majorly increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

icesculpture_crap.name: Cubi I
icesculpture_crap.desc: It's structurally unsound, but otherwise not entirely terrible.

icesculpture_amazing_1.name: Exquisite Chompers
icesculpture_amazing_1.desc: These incisors are the stuff of dental legend.

icesculpture_amazing_2.name: Frosty Crustacean
icesculpture_amazing_2.desc: A charming depiction of the mighty Pokeshell in mid-rampage.

icesculpture_amazing_3.name: The Chase
icesculpture_amazing_3.desc: Some aquarists posit that Pacus are the original creators of the game now known as "Tag."

marblesculpture.name: Marble Block
marblesculpture.desc: Duplicants who have learned art skills can produce more decorative sculptures.
marblesculpture.effect:
Majorly increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

sculpture_marble_crap_1.name: Lumpy Fungus
sculpture_marble_crap_1.desc: The artist was a very fungi.

sculpture_marble_amazing_1.name: The Large-ish Mermaid
sculpture_marble_amazing_1.desc: She's not afraid to take up space.

sculpture_marble_amazing_2.name: Grouchy Beast
sculpture_marble_amazing_2.desc: The artist took great pleasure in conveying their displeasure.

sculpture_marble_amazing_4.name: Truly A-Moo-Zing
sculpture_marble_amazing_4.desc: A masterful celebration of one of the universe's most mysterious - and flatulent - organisms.

sculpture_marble_amazing_5.name: Green Goddess
sculpture_marble_amazing_5.desc: A masterful celebration of the deep bond between a horticulturalist and her prize Bristle Blossom.

metalsculpture.name: Metal Block
metalsculpture.desc: Duplicants who have learned art skills can produce more decorative sculptures.
metalsculpture.effect:
Majorly increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

sculpture_metal_crap_1.name: Unnatural Beauty
sculpture_metal_crap_1.desc: Actually, it's a very good likeness.

sculpture_metal_good_1.name: Beautiful Biohazard
sculpture_metal_good_1.desc: The Morb's eye is mounted on a swivel that activates at random intervals.

sculpture_metal_amazing_1.name: Insatiable Appetite
sculpture_metal_amazing_1.desc: It's quite lovely, until someone stubs their toe on it in the dark.

sculpture_metal_amazing_2.name: Agape
sculpture_metal_amazing_2.desc: Not quite expressionist, but undeniably expressive.

sculpture_metal_amazing_3.name: Friendly Flier
sculpture_metal_amazing_3.desc: It emits no light, but it sure does brighten up a room.

sculpture_metal_amazing_4.name: Whatta Pip
sculpture_metal_amazing_4.desc: A masterful likeness of the mischievous critter that Duplicants love to love.

sculpture_metal_amazing_5.name: Phrenologist's Dream
sculpture_metal_amazing_5.desc: What if the entire head is one big bump?

smallsculpture.name: Sculpting Block
smallsculpture.desc: Duplicants who have learned art skills can produce more decorative sculptures.
smallsculpture.effect:
Minorly increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

sculpture_1x2_good.name: Lunar Slice
sculpture_1x2_good.desc: It must be a moon, because there are no bananas in space.

sculpture_1x2_amazing_4.name: Employee of the Month
sculpture_1x2_amazing_4.desc: A masterful celebration of the Sweepy's unbeatable work ethic and cheerful, can-clean attitude.

sculpture_1x2_amazing_5.name: Pointy Impossibility
sculpture_1x2_amazing_5.desc: A three-dimensional rebellion against the rules of Euclidean space.

sculpture_1x2_amazing_6.name: Fireball
sculpture_1x2_amazing_6.desc: Tribute to the artist's friend, who once attempted to catch a meteor with their bare hands.

woodsculpture.name: Wood Block
woodsculpture.desc: A great fit for smaller spaces.
woodsculpture.effect:
Moderately increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

shearingstation.name: Shearing Station
shearingstation.desc: Those critters aren't gonna shear themselves.
shearingstation.effect:
Shearing stations allow eligible Critters to be safely sheared for useful raw materials.

Visiting this building restores Critters' physical and emotional well-being.

oxygenmaskstation.name: Oxygen Mask Station
oxygenmaskstation.desc: Duplicants can't pass by a station if it lacks enough oxygen to fill a mask.
oxygenmaskstation.effect:
Uses designated Metal Ores from filter settings to create Oxygen Masks.

Automatically draws in ambient Oxygen to fill masks.

Marks a threshold where Duplicants must put on or take off a mask.

Can be rotated before construction.

sweepbotstation.name: Sweepy's Dock
sweepbotstation.desc: The cute little face comes pre-installed.
sweepbotstation.effect:
Deploys an automated Sweepy Bot to sweep up Solid debris and Liquid spills.

Dock stores Liquids and Solids gathered by the Sweepy.

Uses Power to recharge the Sweepy.

Duplicants will empty Dock storage into available storage bins.

oxygenmaskmarker.name: Oxygen Mask Checkpoint
oxygenmaskmarker.desc: A checkpoint must have a correlating dock built on the opposite side its arrow faces.
oxygenmaskmarker.effect:
Marks a threshold where Duplicants must put on or take off an Oxygen Mask.

Must be built next to an Oxygen Mask Dock.

Can be rotated before construction.

oxygenmasklocker.name: Oxygen Mask Dock
oxygenmasklocker.desc: An oxygen mask dock will store and refill masks while they're not in use.
oxygenmasklocker.effect:
Stores Oxygen Masks and refuels them with Oxygen.

Build next to an Oxygen Mask Checkpoint to make Duplicants put on masks when passing by.

suitmarker.name: Atmo Suit Checkpoint
suitmarker.desc: A checkpoint must have a correlating dock built on the opposite side its arrow faces.
suitmarker.effect:
Marks a threshold where Duplicants must change into or out of Atmo Suits.

Must be built next to an Atmo Suit Dock.

Can be rotated before construction.

suitlocker.name: Atmo Suit Dock
suitlocker.desc: An atmo suit dock will empty atmo suits of waste, but only one suit can charge at a time.
suitlocker.effect:
Stores Atmo Suits and refuels them with Oxygen.

Empties suits of Polluted Water.

Build next to an Atmo Suit Checkpoint to make Duplicants change into suits when passing by.

jetsuitmarker.name: Jet Suit Checkpoint
jetsuitmarker.desc: A checkpoint must have a correlating dock built on the opposite side its arrow faces.
jetsuitmarker.effect:
Marks a threshold where Duplicants must change into or out of Jet Suits.

Must be built next to a Jet Suit Dock.

Can be rotated before construction.

jetsuitlocker.name: Jet Suit Dock
jetsuitlocker.desc: Jet suit docks can refill jet suits with air and fuel, or empty them of waste.
jetsuitlocker.effect:
Stores Jet Suits and refuels them with Oxygen and Combustible Liquid.

Empties suits of Polluted Water.

Build next to a Jet Suit Checkpoint to make Duplicants change into suits when passing by.

leadsuitmarker.name: Lead Suit Checkpoint
leadsuitmarker.desc: A checkpoint must have a correlating dock built on the opposite side its arrow faces.
leadsuitmarker.effect:
Marks a threshold where Duplicants must change into or out of Lead Suits.

Must be built next to a Lead Suit Dock

Can be rotated before construction.

leadsuitlocker.name: Lead Suit Dock
leadsuitlocker.desc: Lead suit docks can refill lead suits with air and empty them of waste.
leadsuitlocker.effect:
Stores Lead Suits and refuels them with Oxygen.

Empties suits of Polluted Water.

Build next to a Lead Suit Checkpoint to make Duplicants change into suits when passing by.

craftingtable.name: Crafting Station
craftingtable.desc: Crafting stations allow Duplicants to make oxygen masks to wear in low breathability areas.
craftingtable.effect:
Produces items and equipment for Duplicant use.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

advancedcraftingtable.name: Soldering Station
advancedcraftingtable.desc: Soldering stations allow Duplicants to build helpful Flydo retriever bots.
advancedcraftingtable.effect:
Produces advanced electronics and bionic Boosters.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

advancedcraftingtable.colony_has_booster_assigned_count: My colony has {0} Bionic Duplicant(s) with this booster assigned

dataminer.name: Data Miner
dataminer.desc: Data banks can also be used to program robo-pilot rocket modules.
dataminer.effect:
Mass-produces NAME PLURAL that can be processed into RESEARCH NAME points.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

remoteworkterminal.name: Remote Controller
remoteworkterminal.desc: Remote controllers cut down on colony commute times.
remoteworkterminal.effect: Enables Duplicants to operate machinery remotely via a connected Remote Worker Dock.

remoteworkerdock.name: Remote Worker Dock
remoteworkerdock.effect:
Remote Worker Docks deploy automatons that operate machinery based on instructions received from a connected Remote Controller.

Must be placed within range of its target building.

suitfabricator.name: Exosuit Forge
suitfabricator.desc: Exosuits can be filled with oxygen to allow Duplicants to safely enter hazardous areas.
suitfabricator.effect:
Forges protective Exosuits for Duplicants to wear.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

clothingalterationstation.name: Clothing Refashionator
clothingalterationstation.desc: Allows skilled Duplicants to add extra personal pizzazz to their wardrobe.
clothingalterationstation.effect:
Upgrades Snazzy Suits into Primo Garb.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

clothingfabricator.name: Textile Loom
clothingfabricator.desc: A textile loom can be used to spin Reed Fiber into wearable Duplicant clothing.
clothingfabricator.effect:
Tailors Duplicant Clothing items.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

solidbooster.name: Solid Fuel Thruster
solidbooster.desc: Additional thrusters allow rockets to reach far away space destinations.
solidbooster.effect: Burns Iron and Oxylite to increase rocket exploration distance.

spaceheater.name: Space Heater
spaceheater.desc: Space heaters are a welcome cure for cold, soggy feet.
spaceheater.effect:
Radiates a moderate amount of Heat.

Requires Power in order to function.

spicegrinder.name: Spice Grinder
spicegrinder.desc: Crushed seeds and other edibles make excellent meal-enhancing additives.
spicegrinder.effect: Produces ingredients that add benefits to foods prepared at skilled cooking stations.

smoker.name: Smoker
smoker.desc: With a little patience, even tough meat can become deliciously edible.
smoker.effect:
Cooks improved foods over low, slow heat.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

storagelocker.name: Storage Bin
storagelocker.desc: Resources left on the floor become "debris" and lower decor when not put away.
storagelocker.effect: Stores the Solid Materials of your choosing.

default_storagelocker.name: Storage Bin
default_storagelocker.desc: Resources left on the floor become "debris" and lower decor when not put away.

green_mush.desc: Color-coded storage makes things easier to find.

red_rose.desc: Color-coded storage makes things easier to find.

purple_brainfat.desc: Color-coded storage makes things easier to find.

yellow_tartar.name: Ick Yellow Storage Bin
yellow_tartar.desc: Color-coded storage makes things easier to find.

polka_darknavynookgreen.name: Party Dot Storage Bin
polka_darknavynookgreen.desc: A fun storage solution for fun-damental materials.

polka_darkpurpleresin.name: Mod Dot Storage Bin
polka_darkpurpleresin.desc: Groovy storage, because messy colonies are such a drag.

stripes_red_white.name: Bold Stripe Storage Bin
stripes_red_white.desc: It's the merriest storage bin of all.

storagelockersmart.name: Smart Storage Bin
