liquidheater.name: Liquid Tepidizer
liquidheater.desc: Tepidizers heat liquid which can kill waterborne germs.
liquidheater.effect:
Warms large bodies of Liquid.

Must be fully submerged.

switch.name: Switch
switch.desc: Switches can only affect buildings that come after them on a circuit.
switch.effect:
Turns Power on or off.

Does not affect circuitry preceding the switch.

logicpowerrelay.name: Power Shutoff
logicpowerrelay.desc: Automated systems save power and time by removing the need for Duplicant input.
logicpowerrelay.effect:
Connects to an Automation grid to automatically turn Power on or off.

Does not affect circuitry preceding the switch.
logicpowerrelay.logic_port_active: Green Signal: Allow Power through connected circuits
logicpowerrelay.logic_port_inactive: Red Signal: Prevent Power from flowing through connected circuits

logicinterasteroidsender.name: Automation Broadcaster
logicinterasteroidsender.effect:
Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal to an Automation Receiver over vast distances in space.

Both the Automation Broadcaster and the Automation Receiver must be exposed to space to function.

logicinterasteroidreceiver.name: Automation Receiver
logicinterasteroidreceiver.effect:
Receives a Green Signal or a Red Signal from an Automation Broadcaster over vast distances in space.

Both the Automation Receiver and the Automation Broadcaster must be exposed to space to function.

temperaturecontrolledswitch.name: Thermo Switch
temperaturecontrolledswitch.desc: Automated switches can be used to manage circuits in areas where Duplicants cannot enter.
temperaturecontrolledswitch.effect:
Automatically turns Power on or off using ambient Temperature.

Does not affect circuitry preceding the switch.

pressureswitchliquid.name: Hydro Switch
pressureswitchliquid.desc: A hydro switch shuts off power when the liquid pressure surrounding it surpasses the set threshold.
pressureswitchliquid.effect:
Automatically turns Power on or off using ambient Liquid Pressure.

Does not affect circuitry preceding the switch.

Must be submerged in Liquid.

pressureswitchgas.name: Atmo Switch
pressureswitchgas.desc: An atmo switch shuts off power when the air pressure surrounding it surpasses the set threshold.
pressureswitchgas.effect:
Automatically turns Power on or off using ambient Gas Pressure .

Does not affect circuitry preceding the switch.

tile.name: Tile
tile.desc: Tile can be used to bridge gaps and get to unreachable areas.
tile.effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Increases Duplicant runspeed.

walltoilet.name: Wall Toilet
walltoilet.desc: Wall Toilets transmit fewer germs to Duplicants and require no emptying.
walltoilet.effect:
Gives Duplicants a place to relieve themselves. Empties directly on the other side of the wall.

Spreads very few Germs.

waterpurifier.name: Water Sieve
waterpurifier.desc: Sieves cannot kill germs and pass any they receive into their waste and water output.
waterpurifier.effect:
Produces clean Water from Polluted Water using Sand.

Produces Polluted Dirt.

distillationcolumn.name: Distillation Column
distillationcolumn.effect: Separates any Contaminated Water piped through it into Steam and Polluted Dirt.

wire.name: Wire
wire.desc: Electrical wire is used to connect generators, batteries, and buildings.
wire.effect:
Connects buildings to Power sources.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

wirebridge.name: Wire Bridge
wirebridge.desc: Splitting generators onto separate grids can prevent overloads and wasted electricity.
wirebridge.effect:
Runs one wire section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

highwattagewire.name: Heavi-Watt Wire
highwattagewire.desc: Higher wattage wire is used to avoid power overloads, particularly for strong generators.
highwattagewire.effect:
Carries more Wattage than regular Wire without overloading.

Cannot be run through wall and floor tile.

wirebridgehighwattage.name: Heavi-Watt Joint Plate
wirebridgehighwattage.desc: Joint plates can run Heavi-Watt wires through walls without leaking gas or liquid.
wirebridgehighwattage.effect:
Allows Heavi-Watt Wire to be run through wall and floor tile.

Functions as regular tile.

wirerefined.name: Conductive Wire
wirerefined.desc: My Duplicants prefer the look of conductive wire to the regular raggedy stuff.
wirerefined.effect:
Connects buildings to Power sources.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

wirerefinedbridge.name: Conductive Wire Bridge
wirerefinedbridge.desc: Splitting generators onto separate systems can prevent overloads and wasted electricity.
wirerefinedbridge.effect:
Carries more Wattage than a regular Wire Bridge without overloading.

Runs one wire section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

wirerefinedhighwattage.name: Heavi-Watt Conductive Wire
wirerefinedhighwattage.desc: Higher wattage wire is used to avoid power overloads, particularly for strong generators.
wirerefinedhighwattage.effect:
Carries more Wattage than regular Wire without overloading.

Cannot be run through wall and floor tile.

wirerefinedbridgehighwattage.name: Heavi-Watt Conductive Joint Plate
wirerefinedbridgehighwattage.desc: Joint plates can run Heavi-Watt wires through walls without leaking gas or liquid.
wirerefinedbridgehighwattage.effect:
Carries more Wattage than a regular Heavi-Watt Joint Plate without overloading.

Allows Heavi-Watt Wire to be run through wall and floor tile.

handsanitizer.name: Hand Sanitizer
handsanitizer.desc: Hand sanitizers kill germs more effectively than wash basins.
handsanitizer.effect:
Removes most Germs from Duplicants.

Germ-covered Duplicants use Hand Sanitizers when passing by in the selected direction.

washbasin.name: Wash Basin
washbasin.desc: Germ spread can be reduced by building these where Duplicants often get dirty.
washbasin.effect:
Removes some Germs from Duplicants.

Germ-covered Duplicants use Wash Basins when passing by in the selected direction.

washsink.name: Sink
washsink.desc: Sinks are plumbed and do not need to be manually emptied or refilled.
washsink.effect:
Removes Germs from Duplicants.

Germ-covered Duplicants use Sinks when passing by in the selected direction.

default_washsink.name: Sink
default_washsink.desc: Sinks are plumbed and do not need to be manually emptied or refilled.

purple_brainfat.name: Faint Purple Sink
purple_brainfat.desc: A refreshing splash of color for the light-headed.

blue_babytears.name: Weepy Blue Sink
blue_babytears.desc: A calm, colorful sink for heavy-hearted Duplicants.

yellow_tartar.name: Ick Yellow Sink
yellow_tartar.desc: The juxtaposition of 'ick' and 'clean' can be very satisfying.

red_rose.name: Puce Pink Sink
red_rose.desc: Some Duplicants say it looks like a germ-devouring mouth.

decontaminationshower.name: Decontamination Shower
decontaminationshower.desc: Don't forget to decontaminate behind your ears.
decontaminationshower.effect:
Uses Water to remove Germs and Radiation.

Decontaminates both Duplicants and their Clothing.

tilepoi.name: Tile
tilepoi.effect: Used to build the walls and floor of rooms.

polymerizer.name: Polymer Press
polymerizer.desc: Plastic can be used to craft unique buildings and goods.
polymerizer.effect: Converts Plastic Monomers into raw Plastic.

directionalworldpumpliquid.name: Liquid Channel
directionalworldpumpliquid.desc: Channels move more volume than pumps and require no power, but need sufficient pressure to function.
directionalworldpumpliquid.effect:
Directionally moves large volumes of LIQUID through a channel.

Can be used as floor tile and rotated before construction.

steamturbine.name: [DEPRECATED] Steam Turbine
steamturbine.desc: Useful for converting the geothermal energy of magma into usable power.
steamturbine.effect:
THIS BUILDING HAS BEEN DEPRECATED AND CANNOT BE BUILT.

Generates exceptional electrical Power using pressurized, Scalding Steam.

Outputs significantly cooler Steam than it receives.

Air pressure beneath this building must be higher than pressure above for air to flow.

steamturbine2.name: Steam Turbine
steamturbine2.desc: Useful for converting the geothermal energy into usable power.
steamturbine2.effect:
Draws in Steam from the tiles directly below the machine's foundation and uses it to generate electrical Power.

Outputs Water.

steamengine.name: Steam Engine
steamengine.desc: Rockets can be used to send Duplicants into space and retrieve rare resources.
steamengine.effect:
Utilizes Steam to propel rockets for space exploration.

The engine of a rocket must be built first before more rocket modules may be added.

steamenginecluster.name: Steam Engine
steamenginecluster.desc: Rockets can be used to send Duplicants into space and retrieve rare resources.
steamenginecluster.effect:
Utilizes Steam to propel rockets for space exploration.

Engine must be built via Rocket Platform. 

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

solarpanel.name: Solar Panel
solarpanel.desc: Solar panels convert high intensity sunlight into power and produce zero waste.
solarpanel.effect:
Converts Sunlight into electrical Power.

Must be exposed to space.

cometdetector.name: Space Scanner
cometdetector.desc: Networks of many scanners will scan more efficiently than one on its own.
cometdetector.effect:
Sends a Green Signal to its automation circuit when it detects incoming objects from space.

Can be configured to detect incoming meteor showers or returning space rockets.

oilrefinery.name: Oil Refinery
oilrefinery.desc: Petroleum can only be produced from the refinement of crude oil.
oilrefinery.effect: Converts Crude Oil into Petroleum and Natural Gas.

oilwellcap.name: Oil Well
oilwellcap.desc: Water pumped into an oil reservoir cannot be recovered.
oilwellcap.effect:
Extracts Crude Oil using clean Water.

Must be built atop an Oil Reservoir.

metalrefinery.name: Metal Refinery
metalrefinery.desc: Refined metals are necessary to build advanced electronics and technologies.
metalrefinery.effect:
Produces Refined Metals from raw Metal Ore.

Significantly Heats and outputs the Liquid piped into it.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

missilefabricator.name: Blastshot Maker
missilefabricator.desc: Blastshot shells are an effective defense against incoming meteor showers.
missilefabricator.effect:
Produces Blastshot from Refined Metals combined with Petroleum.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

glassforge.name: Glass Forge
glassforge.desc: Glass can be used to construct window tile.
glassforge.effect:
Produces Molten Glass from raw Sand.

Outputs High Temperature Liquid.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

rockcrusher.name: Rock Crusher
rockcrusher.desc: Rock Crushers loosen nuggets from raw ore and can process many different resources.
rockcrusher.effect:
Inefficiently produces refined materials from raw resources.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.
rockcrusher.lime_from_limestone_recipe_description: Crushes {0} into {1} and a small amount of pure {2}
rockcrusher.resin_from_amber_recipe_description: Crushes {0} into {1} and {2}, and a small amount of {3}

default_rockcrusher.name: Rock Crusher
default_rockcrusher.desc: Rock Crushers loosen nuggets from raw ore and can process many different resources.

teeth.name: Toothy Rock Crusher
teeth.desc: Not designed to handle overcooked food waste.

roundstamp.name: Smooth Rock Crusher
roundstamp.desc: Inspired by the traditional mortar and pestle.

chomp.name: Mani Rock Crusher
chomp.desc: Buffs rough ore into smooth little nuggets.

gears.name: Super-Mech Rock Crusher
gears.desc: Uncrushed ore really grinds its gears.

balloon.name: Pop-A-Rocks-E
balloon.desc: Wherever there's raw ore, there's a rock crusher lurking nearby.

sludgepress.name: Sludge Press
sludgepress.desc: What Duplicant doesn't love playing with mud?
sludgepress.effect:
Separates Mud and other sludges into their base elements.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

chemicalrefinery.name: Emulsifier
chemicalrefinery.desc: It's like a blender, but better.
chemicalrefinery.effect:
Combines Liquids and other inputs into fluid compounds.

Duplicants will not fabricate emulsions unless recipes are queued.
chemicalrefinery.refinedlipid_recipe_description: Biodiesel is a Combustible Liquid used in Power production.
chemicalrefinery.saltwater_recipe_description: Salt Water is a Liquid with insulating and radiation-absorbing properties.

supermaterialrefinery.name: Molecular Forge
supermaterialrefinery.desc: Rare materials can be procured through rocket missions into space.
supermaterialrefinery.effect:
Processes Rare Materials into advanced industrial goods.

Rare materials can be retrieved from space missions.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.
supermaterialrefinery.supercoolant_recipe_description: Super Coolant is an industrial-grade Fullerene coolant.
supermaterialrefinery.superinsulator_recipe_description: Insulite reduces Heat Transfer and is composed of recrystallized Abyssalite.
supermaterialrefinery.tempconductorsolid_recipe_description: Thermium is an industrial metal alloy formulated to maximize Heat Transfer and thermal dispersion.
supermaterialrefinery.viscogel_recipe_description: Visco-Gel Fluid is a Liquid polymer with high surface tension.
supermaterialrefinery.yellowcake_recipe_description: Yellowcake is a Solid Material used in uranium enrichment.
supermaterialrefinery.fullerene_recipe_description: Fullerene is a Solid Material used in the production of Super Coolant.
supermaterialrefinery.hardplastic_recipe_description: Plastium is a highly heat-resistant, plastic-like Solid Material used for space buildings.
supermaterialrefinery.self_charging_powerbank_recipe_descripti: Atomic Power Banks are portable, self-charging units used for isolated Power grids.

thermalblock.name: Tempshift Plate
thermalblock.desc: The thermal properties of construction materials determine their heat retention.
thermalblock.effect:
Accelerates or buffers Heat dispersal based on the construction material used.

Has a small area of effect.

powercontrolstation.name: Power Control Station
powercontrolstation.desc: Only one Duplicant may be assigned to a station at a time.
powercontrolstation.effect:
Produces Microchip to increase the Power output of generators.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the Tune Up trait.

farmstation.name: Farm Station
farmstation.desc: This station only has an effect on crops grown within the same room.
farmstation.effect:
Produces Micronutrient Fertilizer to increase Plant growth rates.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the Crop Tending trait.

This building is a necessary component of the Greenhouse room.

fishdeliverypoint.name: Fish Release
fishdeliverypoint.desc: A fish release must be built in liquid to prevent released fish from suffocating.
fishdeliverypoint.effect:
Releases trapped Pacu back into the world.

Can be used multiple times.

fishfeeder.name: Fish Feeder
fishfeeder.desc: Build this feeder above a body of water to feed the fish within.
fishfeeder.effect:
Automatically dispenses stored Critter food into the area below.

Dispenses continuously as food is consumed.

fishtrap.name: Fish Trap
fishtrap.desc: Trapped fish will automatically be bagged for transport.
fishtrap.effect:
Attracts and traps swimming Pacu.

Single use.

ranchstation.name: Grooming Station
ranchstation.desc: A groomed critter is a happy, healthy, productive critter.
ranchstation.effect:
Allows the assigned Rancher to care for Critters.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the Critter Ranching skill.

machineshop.name: Mechanics Station
machineshop.desc: Duplicants will only improve the efficiency of buildings in the same room as this station.
machineshop.effect:
Allows the assigned Engineer to improve building production efficiency.

This building is a necessary component of the Machine Shop room.

logicwire.name: Automation Wire
logicwire.desc: Automation wire is used to connect building ports to automation gates.
logicwire.effect:
Connects buildings to Sensors.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

logicribbon.name: Automation Ribbon
logicribbon.desc: Logic ribbons use significantly less space to carry multiple automation signals.
logicribbon.effect:
A 4-Bit Automation Wire which can carry up to four automation signals.

Use a Ribbon Writer to output to multiple Bits, and a Ribbon Reader to input from multiple Bits.

logicwirebridge.name: Automation Wire Bridge
logicwirebridge.desc: Wire bridges allow multiple automation grids to exist in a small area without connecting.
logicwirebridge.effect:
Runs one Automation Wire section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
logicwirebridge.logic_port_active: Green Signal: Pass through the Green Signal
logicwirebridge.logic_port_inactive: Red Signal: Pass through the Red Signal

logicribbonbridge.name: Automation Ribbon Bridge
logicribbonbridge.desc: Wire bridges allow multiple automation grids to exist in a small area without connecting.
logicribbonbridge.effect:
Runs one Automation Ribbon section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.
logicribbonbridge.logic_port_active: Green Signal: Pass through the Green Signal
logicribbonbridge.logic_port_inactive: Red Signal: Pass through the Red Signal

logicgateand.name: AND Gate
logicgateand.desc: This gate outputs a Green Signal when both its inputs are receiving Green Signals at the same time.
logicgateand.effect: Outputs a Green Signal when both Input A AND Input B are receiving Green. Outputs a Red Signal when even one Input is receiving Red.
logicgateand.output_active: Sends a Green Signal if both Inputs are receiving Green
logicgateand.output_inactive: Sends a Red Signal if any Input is receiving Red

logicgateor.name: OR Gate
logicgateor.desc: This gate outputs a Green Signal if receiving one or more Green Signals.
logicgateor.effect: Outputs a Green Signal if at least one of Input A OR Input B is receiving Green. Outputs a Red Signal when neither Input A or Input B are receiving Green.
logicgateor.output_active: Sends a Green Signal if any Input is receiving Green
logicgateor.output_inactive: Sends a Red Signal if both Inputs are receiving Red

logicgatenot.name: NOT Gate
logicgatenot.desc: This gate reverses automation signals, turning a Green Signal into a Red Signal and vice versa.
logicgatenot.effect:
Outputs a Green Signal if the Input is receiving a Red Signal.

Outputs a Red Signal when its Input is receiving a Green Signal.
logicgatenot.output_active: Sends a Green Signal if receiving Red
logicgatenot.output_inactive: Sends a Red Signal if receiving Green

logicgatexor.name: XOR Gate
logicgatexor.desc: This gate outputs a Green Signal if exactly one of its Inputs is receiving a Green Signal.
logicgatexor.effect:
Outputs a Green Signal if exactly one of its Inputs is receiving Green.

Outputs a Red Signal if both or neither Inputs are receiving a Green Signal.
logicgatexor.output_active: Sends a Green Signal if exactly one of its Inputs is receiving Green
logicgatexor.output_inactive: Sends a Red Signal if both Input signals match (any color)

logicgatebuffer.name: BUFFER Gate
logicgatebuffer.desc: This gate continues outputting a Green Signal for a short time after the gate stops receiving a Green Signal.
logicgatebuffer.effect:
Outputs a Green Signal if the Input is receiving a Green Signal.

Continues sending a Green Signal for an amount of buffer time after the Input receives a Red Signal.
logicgatebuffer.output_active: Sends a Green Signal while receiving Green. After receiving Red, will continue sending Green until the timer has expired

logicgatefilter.name: FILTER Gate
logicgatefilter.desc: This gate only lets a Green Signal through if its Input has received a Green Signal that lasted longer than the selected filter time.
logicgatefilter.effect:
Only lets a Green Signal through if the Input has received a Green Signal for longer than the selected filter time.

Will continue outputting a Red Signal if the Green Signal did not last long enough.
logicgatefilter.output_active: Sends a Green Signal after receiving Green for longer than the selected filter timer

logicmemory.name: Memory Toggle
logicmemory.desc: A Memory stores a Green Signal received in the Set Port (S) until the Reset Port (R) receives a Green Signal.
logicmemory.effect: Contains an internal Memory, and will output whatever signal is stored in that Memory. Signals sent to the Inputs only affect the Memory, and do not pass through to the Output. Sending a Green Signal to the Set Port (S) will set the memory to Green. Sending a Green Signal to the Reset Port (R) will reset the memory back to Red.
logicmemory.read_port_active: Outputs a Green Signal if the internal Memory is set to Green
logicmemory.read_port_inactive: Outputs a Red Signal if the internal Memory is set to Red
logicmemory.set_port_active: Green Signal: Set the internal Memory to Green
logicmemory.reset_port_active: Green Signal: Reset the internal Memory to Red

logicgatemultiplexer.name: Signal Selector
logicgatemultiplexer.desc: Signal Selectors can be used to select which automation signal is relevant to pass through to a given circuit
logicgatemultiplexer.effect:
Select which one of four Input signals should be sent out the Output, using Control Inputs.

Send a Green Signal or a Red Signal to the two Control Inputs to determine which Input is selected.
logicgatemultiplexer.output_active: Receives a Green or Red signal from the selected input

logicgatedemultiplexer.name: Signal Distributor
logicgatedemultiplexer.desc: Signal Distributors can be used to choose which circuit should receive a given automation signal.
logicgatedemultiplexer.effect:
Route a single Input signal out one of four possible Outputs, based on the selection made by the Control Inputs.

Send a Green Signal or a Red Signal to the two Control Inputs to determine which Output is selected.
logicgatedemultiplexer.output_active: Sends a Green or Red signal to the selected output

logicswitch.name: Signal Switch
logicswitch.desc: Signal switches don't turn grids on and off like power switches, but add an extra signal.
logicswitch.effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal on an Automation grid.
logicswitch.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if toggled ON
logicswitch.logic_port_inactive: Sends a Red Signal if toggled OFF

logicpressuresensorgas.name: Atmo Sensor
logicpressuresensorgas.desc: Atmo sensors can be used to prevent excess oxygen production and overpressurization.
logicpressuresensorgas.effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when Gas pressure enters the chosen range.
logicpressuresensorgas.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if Gas pressure is within the selected range

logicpressuresensorliquid.name: Hydro Sensor
logicpressuresensorliquid.desc: A hydro sensor can tell a pump to refill its basin as soon as it contains too little liquid.
logicpressuresensorliquid.effect:
Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when Liquid pressure enters the chosen range.

Must be submerged in Liquid.
logicpressuresensorliquid.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if Liquid pressure is within the selected range

logictemperaturesensor.name: Thermo Sensor
logictemperaturesensor.desc: Thermo sensors can disable buildings when they approach dangerous temperatures.
logictemperaturesensor.effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when ambient Temperature enters the chosen range.
logictemperaturesensor.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if ambient Temperature is within the selected range

logiclightsensor.name: Light Sensor
logiclightsensor.desc: Light sensors can tell surface bunker doors above solar panels to open or close based on solar light levels.
logiclightsensor.effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when ambient Brightness enters the chosen range.
logiclightsensor.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if ambient Brightness is within the selected range

logicwattagesensor.name: Wattage Sensor
logicwattagesensor.desc: Wattage sensors can send a signal when a building has switched on or off.
logicwattagesensor.effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when Wattage consumed enters the chosen range.
logicwattagesensor.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if current Wattage is within the selected range

logichepsensor.name: Radbolt Sensor
logichepsensor.desc: Radbolt sensors can send a signal when a Radbolt passes over them.
logichepsensor.effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when Radbolts detected enters the chosen range.
logichepsensor.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if detected Radbolts are within the selected range

logictimeofdaysensor.name: Cycle Sensor
logictimeofdaysensor.desc: Cycle sensors ensure systems always turn on at the same time, day or night, every cycle.
logictimeofdaysensor.effect: Sets an automatic Green Signal and Red Signal schedule within one day-night cycle.
logictimeofdaysensor.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if current time is within the selected Green range

logictimersensor.name: Timer Sensor
logictimersensor.desc: Timer sensors create automation schedules for very short or very long periods of time.
logictimersensor.effect: Creates a timer to send Green Signals and Red Signals for specific amounts of time.
logictimersensor.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal for the selected amount of Green time
logictimersensor.logic_port_inactive: Then, sends a Red Signal for the selected amount of Red time

logiccrittercountsensor.name: Critter Sensor
logiccrittercountsensor.desc: Detecting critter populations can help adjust their automated feeding and care regimens.
logiccrittercountsensor.effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on the number of eggs and critters in a room.
logiccrittercountsensor.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if the number of Critters and Eggs in the Room is greater than the selected threshold.

logicclusterlocationsensor.name: Starmap Location Sensor
logicclusterlocationsensor.desc: Starmap Location sensors can signal when a spacecraft is at a certain location
logicclusterlocationsensor.effect: Send Green Signals at the chosen Starmap locations and Red Signals everywhere else.
logicclusterlocationsensor.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signalwhen a spacecraft is at the chosen Starmap locations

logicduplicantsensor.name: Duplicant Motion Sensor
logicduplicantsensor.desc: Motion sensors save power by only enabling buildings when Duplicants are nearby.
logicduplicantsensor.effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on whether a Duplicant is in the sensor's range.
logicduplicantsensor.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal while a Duplicant is in the sensor's tile range

logicdiseasesensor.name: Germ Sensor
logicdiseasesensor.desc: Detecting germ populations can help block off or clean up dangerous areas.
logicdiseasesensor.effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on quantity of surrounding Germs.
logicdiseasesensor.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if the number of Germs is within the selected range

logicelementsensorgas.name: Gas Element Sensor
logicelementsensorgas.desc: These sensors can detect the presence of a specific gas and alter systems accordingly.
logicelementsensorgas.effect:
Sends a Green Signal when the selected Gas is detected on this sensor's tile.

Sends a Red Signal when the selected Gas is not present.
logicelementsensorgas.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if the selected Gas is detected

logicelementsensorliquid.name: Liquid Element Sensor
logicelementsensorliquid.desc: These sensors can detect the presence of a specific liquid and alter systems accordingly.
logicelementsensorliquid.effect:
Sends a Green Signal when the selected Liquid is detected on this sensor's tile.

Sends a Red Signal when the selected Liquid is not present.
logicelementsensorliquid.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if the selected Liquid is detected

logicradiationsensor.name: Radiation Sensor
logicradiationsensor.desc: Radiation sensors can disable buildings when they detect dangerous levels of radiation.
logicradiationsensor.effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when ambient Radiation enters the chosen range.
logicradiationsensor.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if ambient Radiation is within the selected range

gasconduitdiseasesensor.name: Gas Pipe Germ Sensor
gasconduitdiseasesensor.desc: Germ sensors can help control automation behavior in the presence of germs.
gasconduitdiseasesensor.effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on the internal Germ count of the pipe.
gasconduitdiseasesensor.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if the number of Germs in the pipe is within the selected range

liquidconduitdiseasesensor.name: Liquid Pipe Germ Sensor
liquidconduitdiseasesensor.desc: Germ sensors can help control automation behavior in the presence of germs.
liquidconduitdiseasesensor.effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on the internal Germ count of the pipe.
liquidconduitdiseasesensor.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if the number of Germs in the pipe is within the selected range

solidconduitdiseasesensor.name: Conveyor Rail Germ Sensor
solidconduitdiseasesensor.desc: Germ sensors can help control automation behavior in the presence of germs.
solidconduitdiseasesensor.effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on the internal Germ count of the object on the rail.
solidconduitdiseasesensor.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if the number of Germs on the object on the rail is within the selected range

gasconduitelementsensor.name: Gas Pipe Element Sensor
gasconduitelementsensor.desc: Element sensors can be used to detect the presence of a specific gas in a pipe.
gasconduitelementsensor.effect: Sends a Green Signal when the selected Gas is detected within a pipe.
gasconduitelementsensor.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if the configured Gas is detected

liquidconduitelementsensor.name: Liquid Pipe Element Sensor
liquidconduitelementsensor.desc: Element sensors can be used to detect the presence of a specific liquid in a pipe.
liquidconduitelementsensor.effect: Sends a Green Signal when the selected Liquid is detected within a pipe.
liquidconduitelementsensor.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if the configured Liquid is detected within the pipe

solidconduitelementsensor.name: Conveyor Rail Element Sensor
solidconduitelementsensor.desc: Element sensors can be used to detect the presence of a specific item on a rail.
solidconduitelementsensor.effect: Sends a Green Signal when the selected item is detected on a rail.
solidconduitelementsensor.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if the configured item is detected on the rail

gasconduittemperaturesensor.name: Gas Pipe Thermo Sensor
gasconduittemperaturesensor.desc: Thermo sensors disable buildings when their pipe contents reach a certain temperature.
gasconduittemperaturesensor.effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when pipe contents enter the chosen Temperature range.
gasconduittemperaturesensor.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if the contained Gas is within the selected Temperature range

liquidconduittemperaturesensor.name: Liquid Pipe Thermo Sensor
liquidconduittemperaturesensor.desc: Thermo sensors disable buildings when their pipe contents reach a certain temperature.
liquidconduittemperaturesensor.effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when pipe contents enter the chosen Temperature range.
liquidconduittemperaturesensor.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if the contained Liquid is within the selected Temperature range

solidconduittemperaturesensor.name: Conveyor Rail Thermo Sensor
solidconduittemperaturesensor.desc: Thermo sensors disable buildings when their rail contents reach a certain temperature.
solidconduittemperaturesensor.effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when rail contents enter the chosen Temperature range.
solidconduittemperaturesensor.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if the contained item is within the selected Temperature range

logiccounter.name: Signal Counter
logiccounter.desc: For numbers higher than ten connect multiple counters together.
logiccounter.effect:
Counts how many times a Green Signal has been received up to a chosen number.

When the chosen number is reached it sends a Green Signal until it receives another Green Signal, when it resets automatically and begins counting again.
logiccounter.input_port_active: Green Signal: Increase counter by one
logiccounter.output_port_active: Sends a Green Signal when the counter matches the selected value

logicalarm.name: Automated Notifier
logicalarm.desc: Sends a notification when it receives a Green Signal.
logicalarm.effect:
Attach to sensors to send a notification when certain conditions are met.

Notifications can be customized.

pixelpack.name: Pixel Pack
pixelpack.desc: Four pixels which can be individually designated different colors.
pixelpack.effect:
Pixels can be designated a color when it receives a Green Signal and a different color when it receives a Red Signal.

Input from an Automation Wire controls the whole strip. Input from an Automation Ribbon can control individual pixels on the strip.
pixelpack.input_port_active: Green Signal: Display the configured Green Signal pixels
pixelpack.input_port_inactive: Red Signal: Display the configured Red Signal pixels

logichammer.name: Hammer
logichammer.desc: The hammer makes neat sounds when it strikes buildings.
logichammer.effect:
In its default orientation, the hammer strikes the building to the left when it receives a Green Signal.

Each building has a unique sound when struck by the hammer.

The hammer does no damage when it strikes.

logicribbonwriter.name: Ribbon Writer
logicribbonwriter.desc: Translates the signal from an Automation Wire to a single Bit in an Automation Ribbon
logicribbonwriter.effect:
Writes a Green Signal or a Red Signal to the specified Bit of an Automation Ribbon

Automation Ribbon must be used as the output wire to avoid overloading.
logicribbonwriter.input_port_active: Green Signal: Receives Green Signal to be written to selected Bit
logicribbonwriter.input_port_inactive: Red Signal: Receives Red Signal to to be written selected Bit
logicribbonwriter.output_port_active: Green Signal: Writes a Green Signal to selected Bit of an Automation Ribbon
logicribbonwriter.output_port_inactive: Red Signal: Writes a Red Signal to selected Bit of an Automation Ribbon

logicribbonreader.name: Ribbon Reader
logicribbonreader.desc: Inputs the signal from a single Bit in an Automation Ribbon into an Automation Wire.
logicribbonreader.effect: Reads a Green Signal or a Red Signal from the specified Bit of an Automation Ribbon onto an Automation Wire.
logicribbonreader.input_port_active: Green Signal: Reads a Green Signal from selected Bit
logicribbonreader.input_port_inactive: Red Signal: Reads a Red Signal from selected Bit
logicribbonreader.output_port_active: Green Signal: Sends a Green Signal to attached Automation Wire
logicribbonreader.output_port_inactive: Red Signal: Sends a Red Signal to attached Automation Wire

traveltubeentrance.name: Transit Tube Access
traveltubeentrance.desc: Duplicants require access points to enter tubes, but not to exit them.
traveltubeentrance.effect:
Allows Duplicants to enter the connected Transit Tube system.

Stops drawing Power once fully charged.

traveltube.name: Transit Tube
traveltube.desc: Duplicants will only exit a transit tube when a safe landing area is available beneath it.
traveltube.effect:
Quickly transports Duplicants from a Transit Tube Access to the tube's end.

Only transports Duplicants.

traveltubewallbridge.name: Transit Tube Crossing
traveltubewallbridge.desc: Tube crossings can run transit tubes through walls without leaking gas or liquid.
traveltubewallbridge.effect:
Allows Transit Tubes to be run through wall and floor tile.

Functions as regular tile.

solidconduit.name: Conveyor Rail
solidconduit.desc: Rails move materials where they'll be needed most, saving Duplicants the walk.
solidconduit.effect:
Transports Solid Materials on a track between Conveyor Loader and Conveyor Receptacle.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

solidconduitinbox.name: Conveyor Loader
solidconduitinbox.desc: Material filters can be used to determine what resources are sent down the rail.
solidconduitinbox.effect:
Loads Solid Materials onto Conveyor Rail for transport.

Only loads the resources of your choosing.

solidconduitoutbox.name: Conveyor Receptacle
solidconduitoutbox.desc: When materials reach the end of a rail they enter a receptacle to be used by Duplicants.
solidconduitoutbox.effect: Unloads Solid Materials from a Conveyor Rail into storage.

solidtransferarm.name: Auto-Sweeper
solidtransferarm.desc: An auto-sweeper's range can be viewed at any time by clicking on the building.
solidtransferarm.effect:
Automates Sweeping and Supplying errands by sucking up all nearby Debris.

Materials are automatically delivered to any Conveyor Loader, Conveyor Receptacle, storage, or buildings within range.

solidconduitbridge.name: Conveyor Bridge
solidconduitbridge.desc: Separating rail systems helps ensure materials go to the intended destinations.
solidconduitbridge.effect:
Runs one Conveyor Rail section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

solidvent.name: Conveyor Chute
solidvent.desc: When materials reach the end of a rail they are dropped back into the world.
solidvent.effect: Unloads Solid Materials from a Conveyor Rail onto the floor.

solidlogicvalve.name: Conveyor Shutoff
solidlogicvalve.desc: Automated conveyors save power and time by removing the need for Duplicant input.
solidlogicvalve.effect: Connects to an Automation grid to automatically turn Solid Material transport on or off.

solidlimitvalve.name: Conveyor Meter
solidlimitvalve.desc: Conveyor Meters let an exact amount of materials pass through before shutting off.
solidlimitvalve.effect: Connects to an Automation grid to automatically turn material transfer off when the specified amount has passed through it.
solidlimitvalve.output_port_active: Sends a Green Signal if limit has been reached

devpumpsolid.name: Dev Pump Solid
devpumpsolid.desc: Piping a pump's output to a building's intake will send solids to that building.
devpumpsolid.effect: Generates chosen Solid Materials and runs it through Conveyor Rail

autominer.name: Robo-Miner
autominer.desc: A robo-miner's range can be viewed at any time by selecting the building.
autominer.effect: Automatically digs out all materials in a set range.

creaturefeeder.name: Critter Feeder
creaturefeeder.desc: Critters tend to stay close to their food source and wander less when given a feeder.
creaturefeeder.effect: Automatically dispenses food for hungry Critters.

gravitaspedestal.name: Gravitas Pedestal
gravitaspedestal.desc: Perception can be drastically changed by a bit of thoughtful presentation.
gravitaspedestal.effect:
Displays a single object, doubling its Decor value.

Objects with negative Decor will gain some positive Decor when displayed.

itempedestal.name: Pedestal
itempedestal.desc: Perception can be drastically changed by a bit of thoughtful presentation.
itempedestal.effect:
Displays a single object, doubling its Decor value.

Objects with negative Decor will gain some positive Decor when displayed.

default_itempedestal.name: Pedestal
default_itempedestal.desc: Perception can be drastically changed by a bit of thoughtful presentation.

hand.name: Hand of Dupe Pedestal
hand.desc: This pedestal cradles precious objects in the palm of its hand.

crownmoulding.name: Ceiling Trim
crownmoulding.desc: Ceiling trim is a purely decorative addition to one's overhead area.
crownmoulding.effect:
Used to decorate the ceilings of rooms.

Increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

default_crownmoulding.name: Ceiling Trim
default_crownmoulding.desc: Ceiling trim is a purely decorative addition to one's overhead area.

shineornaments.name: Fancy Bug Ceiling Garland
shineornaments.desc: Someone spent their entire weekend gluing ribbons to paper Shine Bug cut-outs, and it shows.

cornermoulding.name: Corner Trim
cornermoulding.desc: Corner trim is a purely decorative addition for ceiling corners.
cornermoulding.effect:
Used to decorate the ceiling corners of rooms.

Increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

default_cornermoulding.name: Corner Trim
default_cornermoulding.desc: It really dresses up a ceiling corner.

shineornaments.name: Fancy Bug Corner Garland
shineornaments.desc: Why deck the halls, when you could festoon them?

eggincubator.name: Incubator
eggincubator.desc: Incubators can maintain the ideal internal conditions for several species of critter egg.
eggincubator.effect:
Incubates Critter eggs until ready to hatch.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the Critter Ranching skill.

eggcracker.name: Egg Cracker
eggcracker.desc: Raw eggs are an ingredient in certain high quality food recipes.
eggcracker.effect:
Converts viable Critter eggs into cooking ingredients.

Cracked Eggs cannot hatch.

Duplicants will not crack eggs unless tasks are queued.

hands.name: Handy Cracker
hands.desc: Just like Mi-Ma used to have.

uraniumcentrifuge.name: Uranium Centrifuge
uraniumcentrifuge.desc: Enriched uranium is a specialized substance that can be used to fuel powerful research reactors.
uraniumcentrifuge.effect:
Extracts Enriched Uranium from Uranium Ore.

Outputs Depleted Uranium in molten form.
uraniumcentrifuge.recipe_description: Convert Uranium ore to Molten Uranium and Enriched Uranium

highenergyparticleredirector.name: Radbolt Reflector
highenergyparticleredirector.desc: We were all out of mirrors.
highenergyparticleredirector.effect: Receives and redirects Radbolts from Radbolt Generators.

manualhighenergyparticlespawner.name: Manual Radbolt Generator
manualhighenergyparticlespawner.desc: Radbolts are necessary for producing Materials Science research.
manualhighenergyparticlespawner.effect:
Refines radioactive ores to generate Radbolts.

Emits generated Radbolts in the direction of your choosing.
manualhighenergyparticlespawner.recipe_description: Creates Radbolts by processing {0}. Also creates {1} as a byproduct.

highenergyparticlespawner.name: Radbolt Generator
highenergyparticlespawner.desc: Radbolts are necessary for producing Materials Science research.
highenergyparticlespawner.effect:
Attracts nearby Radiation to generate Radbolts.

Emits generated Radbolts in the direction of your choosing when the set Radbolt threshold is reached.

Radbolts collected will gradually decay while this building is disabled.
highenergyparticlespawner.logic_port_inactive: Red Signal: Do not emit Radbolts

devhepspawner.name: Dev Radbolt Generator
devhepspawner.desc: Radbolts are necessary for producing Materials Science research.
devhepspawner.logic_port_inactive: Red Signal: Do not emit Radbolts

hepbattery.name: Radbolt Chamber
hepbattery.desc: Particles packed up and ready to go.
hepbattery.effect:
Stores Radbolts in a high-energy state, ready for transport.

Requires a Green Signal to release radbolts from storage when the Radbolt threshold is reached.

Radbolts in storage will rapidly decay while this building is disabled.
hepbattery.logic_port_inactive: Red Signal: Do not emit Radbolts
hepbattery.logic_port_storage_active: Sends a Green Signal when its Radbolt Storage is full

hepbridgetile.name: Radbolt Joint Plate
hepbridgetile.desc: Allows Radbolts to pass through walls.
hepbridgetile.effect: Receives Radbolts from Radbolt Generators and directs them through walls. All other materials and elements will be blocked from passage.

astronauttrainingcenter.name: Space Cadet Centrifuge
astronauttrainingcenter.desc: Duplicants must complete astronaut training in order to pilot space rockets.
astronauttrainingcenter.effect:
Trains Duplicants to become Astronaut.

Duplicants must possess the Astronaut trait to receive training.

hottub.name: Hot Tub
hottub.desc: Relaxes Duplicants with massaging jets of heated liquid.
hottub.effect:
Requires Pipes to and from tub and Power to run the jets.

Water must be a comfortable temperature and will cool rapidly.

Increases Duplicant Morale and leaves them feeling deliciously warm.
hottub.water_requirement_tooltip: This building must be filled with {amount} {element} in order to function.
hottub.temperature_requirement_tooltip: The Hot Tub will only be usable if supplied with {temperature} {element}. If the {element} gets too cold, the Hot Tub will drain and require refilling with {element}.

sodafountain.name: Soda Fountain
sodafountain.desc: Sparkling water puts a twinkle in a Duplicant's eye.
sodafountain.effect:
Creates soda from Water and Carbon Dioxide.

Consuming soda water increases Duplicant Morale.

unconstructedrocketmodule.name: Empty Rocket Module
unconstructedrocketmodule.desc: Something useful could be put here someday
unconstructedrocketmodule.effect: Can be changed into a different rocket module

milkfatseparator.name: Brackwax Gleaner
milkfatseparator.desc: Duplicants can slather up with brackwax to increase their travel speed in transit tubes.
milkfatseparator.effect: Refines Brackene into Brine and Brackwax, and emits Carbon Dioxide.

milkfeeder.name: Critter Fountain
milkfeeder.desc: It's easier to tolerate overcrowding when you're all hopped up on brackene.
milkfeeder.effect:
Dispenses Brackene to a wide variety of Critters.

Accessing the fountain significantly improves Critters' moods.

milkingstation.name: Milking Station
milkingstation.desc: Brackene can be used at the Critter Fountain to improve critters' moods.
milkingstation.effect: Allows Duplicants with the Critter Ranching II skill to milk Moos for  Brackene or  Biodiesel.

modularlaunchpadportgas.name: Gas Rocket Port Loader
modularlaunchpadportgas.desc: Rockets must be landed to load or unload resources.
modularlaunchpadportgas.effect:
Loads Gases to the storage of a linked rocket.

Automatically links when built to the side of a Rocket Platform or another Rocket Port.

Uses the gas filters set on the rocket's cargo bays.

modularlaunchpadportbridge.name: Rocket Port Extension
modularlaunchpadportbridge.desc: Allows rocket platforms to be built farther apart.
modularlaunchpadportbridge.effect: Automatically links when built to the side of a Rocket Platform or any Rocket Port.

modularlaunchpadportliquid.name: Liquid Rocket Port Loader
modularlaunchpadportliquid.desc: Rockets must be landed to load or unload resources.
modularlaunchpadportliquid.effect:
Loads Liquids to the storage of a linked rocket.

Automatically links when built to the side of a Rocket Platform or another Rocket Port.

Uses the liquid filters set on the rocket's cargo bays.

modularlaunchpadportsolid.name: Solid Rocket Port Loader
modularlaunchpadportsolid.desc: Rockets must be landed to load or unload resources.
modularlaunchpadportsolid.effect:
Loads Solids to the storage of a linked rocket.

Automatically links when built to the side of a Rocket Platform or another Rocket Port.

Uses the solid material filters set on the rocket's cargo bays.

modularlaunchpadportgasunloader.name: Gas Rocket Port Unloader
modularlaunchpadportgasunloader.desc: Rockets must be landed to load or unload resources.
modularlaunchpadportgasunloader.effect:
Unloads Gases from the storage of a linked rocket.

Automatically links when built to the side of a Rocket Platform or another Rocket Port.

Uses the gas filters set on this unloader.

modularlaunchpadportliquidunloader.name: Liquid Rocket Port Unloader
modularlaunchpadportliquidunloader.desc: Rockets must be landed to load or unload resources.
modularlaunchpadportliquidunloader.effect:
Unloads Liquids from the storage of a linked rocket.

Automatically links when built to the side of a Rocket Platform or another Rocket Port.

Uses the liquid filters set on this unloader.

modularlaunchpadportsolidunloader.name: Solid Rocket Port Unloader
modularlaunchpadportsolidunloader.desc: Rockets must be landed to load or unload resources.
modularlaunchpadportsolidunloader.effect:
Unloads Solids from the storage of a linked rocket.

Automatically links when built to the side of a Rocket Platform or another Rocket Port.

Uses the solid material filters set on this unloader.

stickerbomb.name: Sticker Bomb
stickerbomb.desc: Surprise decor sneak attacks a Duplicant's gloomy day.

heatcompressor.name: Liquid Heatquilizer
heatcompressor.effect: Heats or cools Liquid to match ambient Air Temperature.

partycake.name: Triple Decker Cake
partycake.desc: Any way you slice it, that's a good looking cake.
partycake.effect:
Increases Decor, contributing to Morale.

Adds a Morale bonus to Duplicants' parties.

railgun.name: Interplanetary Launcher
railgun.desc: It's tempting to climb inside but trust me... don't.
railgun.effect:
Launches Interplanetary Payloads between Planetoids.

Payloads can contain Solid, Liquid, or Gas materials.

Cannot transport Duplicants.

railgunpayloadopener.name: Payload Opener
railgunpayloadopener.desc: Payload openers can be hooked up to conveyors, plumbing and ventilation for improved sorting.
railgunpayloadopener.effect:
Unpacks Interplanetary Payloads delivered by Duplicants.

Automatically separates Solid, Liquid, and Gas materials and distributes them to the appropriate systems.

landingbeacon.name: Targeting Beacon
landingbeacon.desc: Microtarget where your Interplanetary Payload lands on a Planetoid surface.
landingbeacon.effect:
Guides Interplanetary Payloads and Orbital Cargo Modules to land nearby.

Interplanetary Payloads must be launched from a Interplanetary Launcher.

diamondpress.name: Diamond Press
diamondpress.effect:
Uses Power and Radbolts to crush Refined Carbon into Diamond.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued and Refined Carbon has been discovered.

escapepod.name: Escape Pod
escapepod.desc: Delivers a Duplicant from a stranded rocket to the nearest Planetoid.

rocketinteriorliquidoutputport.name: Liquid Spacefarer Output Port
rocketinteriorliquidoutputport.desc: A direct attachment to the input port on the exterior of a rocket.
rocketinteriorliquidoutputport.effect: Allows a direct conduit connection into the Spacefarer Module of a rocket.

rocketinteriorliquidinputport.name: Liquid Spacefarer Input Port
rocketinteriorliquidinputport.desc: A direct attachment to the output port on the exterior of a rocket.
rocketinteriorliquidinputport.effect:
Allows a direct conduit connection out of the Spacefarer Module of a rocket.
Can be used to vent Liquids to space during flight.

rocketinteriorgasoutputport.name: Gas Spacefarer Output Port
rocketinteriorgasoutputport.desc: A direct attachment to the input port on the exterior of a rocket.
rocketinteriorgasoutputport.effect: Allows a direct conduit connection into the Spacefarer Module of a rocket.

rocketinteriorgasinputport.name: Gas Spacefarer Input Port
rocketinteriorgasinputport.desc: A direct attachment leading to the output port on the exterior of the rocket.
rocketinteriorgasinputport.effect:
Allows a direct conduit connection out of the Spacefarer Module of the rocket.
Can be used to vent Gasses to space during flight.

missilelauncher.name: Meteor Blaster
missilelauncher.desc: Some meteors drop harvestable resources when they're blown to smithereens.
missilelauncher.effect:
Fires explosive projectiles at incoming space objects to defend the colony from impact-related damage.

Projectiles must be crafted at a Blastshot Maker.

Range: 16 tiles horizontally, 32 tiles vertically.

body.container1:
Fires Blastshot shells at meteor showers to defend the colony from impact-related damage.

Range: 16 tiles horizontally, 32 tiles vertically.

Meteors that have been blown to smithereens leave behind no harvestable resources.

crittercondo.name: Critter Condo
crittercondo.desc: It's nice to have nice things.
crittercondo.effect: Provides a comfortable lounge area that boosts Critter happiness.

underwatercrittercondo.name: Water Fort
underwatercrittercondo.desc: Even wild critters are happier after they've had a little R&R.
underwatercrittercondo.effect: A fancy respite area for adult Pokeshells and Pacu.

airbornecrittercondo.name: Airborne Critter Condo
airbornecrittercondo.desc: Triggers natural nesting instincts and improves critters' moods.
airbornecrittercondo.effect: A hanging respite area for adult Pufts, Moos and Shine Bugs.

massiveheatsink.name: Anti Entropy Thermo-Nullifier
massiveheatsink.effect:
A self-sustaining machine powered by what appears to be refined Neutronium.

Absorbs and neutralizes Heat energy when provided with piped Hydrogen Gas.

megabraintank.name: Somnium Synthesizer
megabraintank.effect:
An organic multi-cortex repository and processing system fuelled by Oxygen.

Analyzes Dream Journals produced by Duplicants wearing Pajamas.

Provides a sustainable boost to Duplicant skills and abilities throughout the colony.

gravitascreaturemanipulator.name: Critter Flux-O-Matic
gravitascreaturemanipulator.effect:
An experimental DNA manipulator.

Analyzes Critters to transform base morphs into random variants of their species.

hijackedheadquarters.name: Printerceptor
hijackedheadquarters.desc: The access code required to reboot it for testing is located somewhere on this world.
hijackedheadquarters.effect: An unsanctioned bioprinter that runs on power siphoned from the Printing Pod.

hijackedheadquarters_completed.name: Printerceptor
hijackedheadquarters_completed.effect:
Intercepts and stores Power charges from the Printing Pod.

Converts stored charges and NAME PLURAL into Seeds and Eggs.

poibunkerexteriordoor.name: Security Door
poibunkerexteriordoor.effect: A strong door with a sophisticated genetic lock.

poidoorinternal.name: Security Door
poidoorinternal.effect: A strong door with a sophisticated genetic lock.

poifacilitydoor.name: Lobby Doors
poifacilitydoor.effect: Large double doors that were once the main entrance to a large facility.

poidlc2showroomdoor.name: Showroom Doors
poidlc2showroomdoor.effect: Large double doors identical to those you might find at the main entrance to a large facility.

geneshuffler.name: Neural Vacillator
geneshuffler.desc:
A massive synthetic brain, suspended in saline solution.

There is a chair attached to the device with room for one person.

proptallplant.name: Potted Plant
proptallplant.desc: Looking closely, it appears to be fake.

propdesk.name: Computer Desk
propdesk.desc: An intact office desk, decorated with several personal belongings and a barely functioning computer.

propfacilitychair.name: Lobby Chair
propfacilitychair.desc: A chair where visitors can comfortably wait before their appointments.

propfacilitycouch.name: Lobby Couch
propfacilitycouch.desc: A couch where visitors can comfortably wait before their appointments.

propfacilitydesk.name: Director's Desk
propfacilitydesk.desc:
A spotless desk filled with impeccably organized office supplies.

A photo peeks out from beneath the desk pad, depicting two beaming young women in caps and gowns.

The photo is quite old.

propfacilitytable.name: Coffee Table
propfacilitytable.desc: A low coffee table that may have once held old science magazines.

propfacilitystatue.name: Gravitas Monument
propfacilitystatue.desc:
A large, modern sculpture that sits in the center of the lobby.

It's an artistic cross between an hourglass shape and a double helix.

propfacilitychandelier.name: Chandelier
propfacilitychandelier.desc:
A large chandelier that hangs from the ceiling.

It does not appear to function.

propfacilityglobedroors.name: Filing Cabinet
propfacilityglobedroors.desc:
A filing cabinet for storing hard copy employee records.

The contents have been shredded.

propfacilitydisplay1.name: Electronic Display
propfacilitydisplay1.desc:
An electronic display projecting the blueprint of a familiar device.

It looks like a Printing Pod.

propfacilitydisplay2.name: Electronic Display
propfacilitydisplay2.desc:
An electronic display projecting the blueprint of a familiar device.

It looks like a Mining Gun.

propfacilitydisplay3.name: Electronic Display
propfacilitydisplay3.desc:
An electronic display projecting the blueprint of a strange device.

Perhaps these displays were used to entice visitors.

propfacilitytallplant.name: Office Plant
propfacilitytallplant.desc: It's survived the vacuum of space by virtue of being plastic.

propfacilitylamp.name: Light Fixture
propfacilitylamp.desc:
A long light fixture that hangs from the ceiling.

It does not appear to function.

propfacilitywalldegree.name: Doctorate Degree
propfacilitywalldegree.desc: Certification in Applied Physics, awarded in recognition of one "Jacquelyn A. Stern".

propfacilitypainting.name: Landscape Portrait
propfacilitypainting.desc:
A painting featuring a copse of fir trees and a magnificent mountain range on the horizon.

The air in the room prickles with the sensation that I'm not meant to be here.

propreceptiondesk.name: Reception Desk
propreceptiondesk.desc:
A full coffee cup and a note abandoned mid sentence sit behind the desk.

It gives me an eerie feeling, as if the receptionist has stepped out and will return any moment.

propelevator.name: Broken Elevator
propelevator.desc:
Out of service.

The buttons inside indicate it went down more than a dozen floors at one point in time.

setlocker.name: Locker
setlocker.desc:
A basic metal locker.

It contains an assortment of personal effects.

propexosetlocker.name: Off-site Locker
propexosetlocker.desc:
A locker made with ultra-lightweight textiles.

It contains an assortment of personal effects.

missilesetlocker.name: Explosives Locker
missilesetlocker.desc:
A locker that once belonged to an explosives engineer.

It holds one Intracosmic Blastshot.

propgravitassmallseedlocker.name: Wall Cabinet
propgravitassmallseedlocker.desc:
A small glass cabinet.

There's a biohazard symbol on it.

proplight.name: Light Fixture
proplight.desc: An elegant ceiling lamp, slightly worse for wear.

propskeleton.name: Model Skeleton
propskeleton.desc:
A detailed anatomical model.

It appears to be made of resin.

propsurfacesatellite1.name: Crashed Satellite
propsurfacesatellite1.desc: All that remains of a once peacefully orbiting satellite.

propsurfacesatellite2.name: Wrecked Satellite
propsurfacesatellite2.desc: All that remains of a once peacefully orbiting satellite.

propsurfacesatellite3.name: Crushed Satellite
propsurfacesatellite3.desc: All that remains of a once peacefully orbiting satellite.

propclock.name: Clock
propclock.desc:
A simple wall clock.

It is no longer ticking.

propgravitasdecorativewindow.name: Window
propgravitasdecorativewindow.desc: A tall, thin window which once pointed to a courtyard.

propgravitasdesk.name: Biophysics Research Desk
propgravitasdesk.desc: The unkempt workspace of a long-departed scientist who expected to return.

propgravitasfridge.name: Mini Fridge
propgravitasfridge.desc:
A non-functional cold storage unit full of expired samples.

It was originally someone's home appliance.

propgravitasclocksquare.name: Clock
propgravitasclocksquare.desc:
A square wall clock.

It's quite damaged.

propgravitasceilinglight.name: Light Fixture
propgravitasceilinglight.desc:
A flush mount ceiling light that no longer functions.

There's dust inside.

propgravitasposterplants.name: Wall Chart
propgravitasposterplants.desc:
A handy reference text with illustrations.

It details the genetic makeup of proprietary botanicals.

propgravitasposterseed.name: Wall Chart
propgravitasposterseed.desc:
A handy reference text with illustrations.

It compares the genetic makeup of select organisms.

propgravitaspotplantdead.name: Dead Plant
propgravitaspotplantdead.desc:
A very dead plant.

It's a wonder it hasn't crumbled into nothingness.

propgravitasflipphone.name: Flip Phone
propgravitasflipphone.desc:
An outdated phone left behind by a distracted lab technician.

It doesn't work.

gravitasbathroomstall.name: Toilet
gravitasbathroomstall.effect:
A private toilet for senior scientists.

It was the site of many great scientific breakthroughs.

propgravitasbathroommirror.name: Mirror
propgravitasbathroommirror.desc:
A one-way mirror and shelf.

The skincare products still smell faintly of shea butter.

propgravitastrashcan.name: Trash Can
propgravitastrashcan.desc:
A wall-mounted garbage receptacle.

The lid does not close.

propgravitasbathroomtoiletpaperholder.name: Toilet Paper Holder
propgravitasbathroomtoiletpaperholder.desc:
It holds one roll of sanitary paper.

The sheets are single-ply.

propgravitasbathroomsink.name: Enamel Sink
propgravitasbathroomsink.desc:
A handwashing station that looks suspiciously under-utilized.

It was once part of a bulk office order.

propgravitaspapertoleldispenser.name: Paper Towel Dispenser
propgravitaspapertoleldispenser.desc:
It once dispensed paper made from 100% post-consumer recycled content.

The remaining sheet is jammed.

propgravitaslabwindow.name: Lab Window
propgravitaslabwindow.effect: A lab window. Formerly a portal to the outside world.

propgravitaslabwindowhorizontal.name: Lab Window
propgravitaslabwindowhorizontal.effect:
A lab window.

Someone once stared out of this, contemplating the results of an experiment.

propgravitaslabwall.name: Lab Wall
propgravitaslabwall.effect: A regular wall that once existed in a working lab.

gravitascontainer.name: Pajama Cubby
gravitascontainer.effect:
A clothing storage unit.

It contains ultra-soft sleepwear.

gravitaslablight.name: LED Light
gravitaslablight.effect: An overhead light therapy lamp designed to soothe the minds.

gravitasdoor.name: Gravitas Door
gravitasdoor.effect: An office door to an office that no longer exists.

propgravitaswall.name: Wall
propgravitaswall.effect: The wall of a once-great scientific facility.

propgravitaswallpurple.name: Wall
propgravitaswallpurple.effect: The wall of an ambitious research and development department.

propgravitaswallpurplewhitediagonal.name: Wall
propgravitaswallpurplewhitediagonal.effect: The wall of an ambitious research and development department.

propgravitasdisplay4.name: Electronic Display
propgravitasdisplay4.desc:
An electronic display projecting the blueprint of a robotic device.

It looks like a ceiling robot.

propdlc2display1.name: Electronic Display
propdlc2display1.desc:
An electronic display projecting the blueprint of an engineering project.

It looks like a pump of some kind.

propgravitasceilingrobot.name: Ceiling Robot
propgravitasceilingrobot.desc: Non-functioning robotic arms that once assisted lab technicians.

propgravitasfloorrobot.name: Robotic Arm
propgravitasfloorrobot.desc: The grasping robotic claw designed to assist technicians in a lab.

propgravitasjar1.name: Big Brain Jar
propgravitasjar1.desc: An abnormally large brain floating in embalming liquid to prevent decomposition.

propgravitascreatureposter.name: Anatomy Poster
propgravitascreatureposter.desc:
An anatomical illustration of the very first Hatch ever produced.

While the ratio of egg sac to brain may appear outlandish, it is in fact to scale.

propgravitasdeskpodium.name: Computer Podium
propgravitasdeskpodium.desc:
A clutter-proof desk to minimize distractions.

There appears to be something stored in the computer.

propgravitasfirstaidkit.name: First Aid Kit
propgravitasfirstaidkit.desc: It looks like it's been used a lot.

propgravitashandscanner.name: Hand Scanner
propgravitashandscanner.desc:
A sophisticated security device.

It appears to use a method other than fingerprints to verify an individual's identity.

propgravitaslabtable.name: Lab Desk
propgravitaslabtable.desc:
The quaint research desk of a departed lab technician.

Perhaps the computer stores something of interest.

propgravitasrobtictable.name: Robotics Research Desk
propgravitasrobtictable.desc: The work space of an extinct robotics technician who left behind some unfinished prototypes.

propdlc2geothermalcart.name: Service Cart
propdlc2geothermalcart.desc:
Maintenance equipment that once flushed debris out of complex mechanisms.

One of the wheels is squeaky.

propgravitasshelf.name: Shelf
propgravitasshelf.desc: A shelf holding jars just out of reach for a short person.

propgravitastoolshelf.name: Tool Rack
propgravitastoolshelf.desc: A wall-mounted rack for storing and displaying useful tools at a not-so-useful height.

propgravitastoolcrate.name: Tool Crate
propgravitastoolcrate.desc:
A packing crate intended for safety equipment.

It has been repurposed for tool storage.

propgravitasfireextinguisher.name: Broken Fire Extinguisher
propgravitasfireextinguisher.desc:
Essential lab equipment.

The inspection tag indicates it has long expired.

propgravitasjar2.name: Sample Jar
propgravitasjar2.desc: The corpse of a proto-hatch creature meticulously preserved in a jar.

propexoshelflong.name: Long Prefab Shelf
propexoshelflong.desc:
A shelf made out of flat-packed pieces that can be assembled in various ways.

This is the long way.

propexoshelshort.name: Prefab Shelf
propexoshelshort.desc:
A shelf made out of flat-packed pieces that can be assembled in various ways.

It looks nice, actually.

prophumanmurphybed.name: Murphy Bed
prophumanmurphybed.desc:
A bed that folds into the wall, for small live/work spaces.

This is the display model.

prophumanchesterfieldsofa.name: Showroom Couch
prophumanchesterfieldsofa.desc: A luxurious couch where potential residents can comfortably nap and dream of home.

prophumanchesterfieldchair.name: Showroom Chair
prophumanchesterfieldchair.desc: A luxurious chair where future generations can comfortably sit and dream of home.

warpconduitreceiver.name: Supply Teleporter Output
warpconduitreceiver.desc: The tubes at the back disappear into nowhere.
warpconduitreceiver.effect:
A machine capable of teleporting Liquid, Solid, and Gas resources to another asteroid.

It can be activated by a Duplicant with the Field Research skill.

This is the receiving side.

warpconduitsender.name: Supply Teleporter Input
warpconduitsender.desc: The tubes at the back disappear into nowhere.
warpconduitsender.effect:
A machine capable of teleporting Liquid, Solid, and Gas resources to another asteroid.

It can be activated by a Duplicant with the Field Research skill.

This is the transmitting side.

warpportal.name: Teleporter Transmitter
warpportal.desc:
The functional remnants of an intricate teleportation system.

This is the outgoing side, and has one pre-programmed destination.

warpreceiver.name: Teleporter Receiver
warpreceiver.desc:
The functional remnants of an intricate teleportation system.

This is the incoming side.

temporaltearopener.name: Temporal Tear Opener
temporaltearopener.desc: Infinite possibilities, with a complimentary side of meteor showers.
temporaltearopener.effect: A powerful mechanism capable of tearing through the fabric of reality.

lonelyminionhouse.name: Gravitas Shipping Container
lonelyminionhouse.desc: Its occupant has been alone for so long, he's forgotten what friendship feels like.
lonelyminionhouse.effect:
A large transport unit from the facility's sub-sub-basement.

It has been modified into a crude yet functional temporary shelter.

lonelyminionhouse_complete.name: Gravitas Shipping Container
lonelyminionhouse_complete.desc: Someone lived inside it for a while.
lonelyminionhouse_complete.effect: A super-spacious container for the Solid Materials of your choosing.

lonelymailbox.name: Mailbox
lonelymailbox.desc: There's nothing quite like receiving homemade gifts in the mail.

plasticflowers.name: Plastic Flowers
plasticflowers.description: Maintenance-free blooms that will outlive us all.
plasticflowers.lore_dlc2: Manufactured by Home Staging Heroes Ltd. as commissioned by the Gravitas Facility, to "Make Space Feel More Like Home." This bouquet is designed to smell like freshly baked cookies.

fountainpen.name: Fountain Pen
fountainpen.description: Cuts through red tape better than a sword ever could.
fountainpen.lore_dlc2:
The handcrafted gold nib features a triangular logo with the letters V and I inside.

Its owner was too proud to report it stolen, and would be shocked to learn of its whereabouts.

propclotheshanger.name: Coat Rack
propclotheshanger.desc:
Holds one Warm Coat.

It'd be silly not to use it.

propcerespostera.name: Travel Poster
propcerespostera.desc:
A poster promoting a local tourist attraction.

Actual scenery may vary.

propceresposterb.name: Travel Poster
propceresposterb.desc:
A poster promoting local wildlife.

The first in an unfinished series.

propceresposterlarge.name: Acoustic Art Panel
propceresposterlarge.desc:
A sound-absorbing panel that makes small-space living more bearable.

The artwork features a  power source.

chlorinator.name: Bleach Stone Hopper
chlorinator.desc: Bleach stone is useful for sanitation and geotuning.
chlorinator.effect: Uses Salt and Gold to produce Bleach Stone.

milkpress.name: Plant Pulverizer
milkpress.desc: For Duplicants who are too squeamish to milk critters.
milkpress.effect:
Crushes organic materials to extract liquids such as Brackene or Phyto Oil.

Brackene can be used to refill the Critter Fountain.
milkpress.resin_from_amber_recipe_description: Converts {0} into {1}, {2}, and a small amount of {3}

fooddehydrator.name: Dehydrator
fooddehydrator.desc: Some of the eliminated liquid inevitably ends up on the floor.
fooddehydrator.effect:
Uses low, even heat to eliminate moisture from eligible Foods and render them shelf-stable.

Dehydrated meals must be processed at the Rehydrator before they can be eaten.
fooddehydrator.result_description: Dehydrated portions of {0} do not require refrigeration.

foodrehydrator.name: Rehydrator
foodrehydrator.desc: Rehydrated food is nutritious and only slightly less delicious.
foodrehydrator.effect: Restores moisture to convert shelf-stable packaged meals into edible Food.

geothermalcontroller.name: Geothermal Heat Pump
geothermalcontroller.desc: What comes out depends very much on the initial temperature of what goes in.
geothermalcontroller.effect:
Uses Heat from the planet's core to dramatically increase the temperature of Liquid inputs.

Materials will be emitted at connected Geo Vents.

geothermalvent.name: Geo Vent
geothermalvent.desc: Geo vents must finish their current emission before accepting new materials.
geothermalvent.effect: Emits high-temperature materials received from the Geothermal Heat Pump.
geothermalvent.blocked_desc: Blocked geo vents can be cleared by pumping in liquids that are hot enough to melt Lead.
geothermalvent.logic_port_active: Sends a Green Signal when geo vent has materials to emit
